  • Paid-Team in Frankreich: Du nutzt bestehende Playbooks, Kampagnenstrukturen und Erkenntnisse aus SEA und Affiliate-Marketing als Grundlage für den deutschen Markt.

  • Growth Engineering und Data: Gemeinsam sorgt ihr für zuverlässiges Tracking, aussagekräftige Attribution, Dashboards und fundierte Performance-Analysen.

  • Website-Team: Ihr stimmt Paid-Landingpages auf die Kampagnen ab und verbessert gemeinsam die Conversion.

  • Brand & Design, Content und Product Marketing: Zusammen entwickelt ihr Creatives und Botschaften, die im deutschen Markt überzeugen.

  • GTM- und Sales-Team Deutschland: Ihr stimmt Lead-Volumen und Lead-Qualität aufeinander ab und nutzt das Feedback aus dem Vertrieb zur laufenden Optimierung.

Deine Aufgaben

1. Paid-Strategie entwickeln und Kampagnen umsetzen

  • Du verantwortest den deutschen Kanal-Mix: Google Ads mit Search, Display und Performance Max, Paid Social auf LinkedIn und Meta sowie bei Bedarf Affiliate-Marketing.

  • Du entwickelst, startest und optimierst Kampagnen – von Targeting, Gebotsstrategien und Zielgruppen über Keywords bis zu Creatives.

  • Du passt Kampagnen und Botschaften an den deutschen Markt und die Bedürfnisse unserer Zielgruppen an.

2. Budget und Performance steuern

  • Du verantwortest das deutsche Paid-Budget, verteilst es auf die passenden Kanäle und optimierst die Effizienz anhand unserer CAC-, CPA- und ROAS-Ziele.

  • Du steigerst das Volumen qualifizierter Leads und stellst gemeinsam mit dem deutschen Sales-Team sicher, dass die Qualität stimmt.

  • Du berichtest Ergebnisse und Erkenntnisse an das Growth-Leadership-Team und leitest konkrete nächste Schritte ab.

3. Wirkung messen und kontinuierlich optimieren

  • Gemeinsam mit Growth Engineering und Data entwickelst du Tracking, Attribution und Dashboards weiter.

  • Du testest laufend neue Creatives, Zielgruppen, Landingpages und Gebotsstrategien und überführst erfolgreiche Ansätze in die Skalierung.

  • Mit dem Website-Team optimierst du die Landingpages und verbesserst die Conversion entlang des gesamten Funnels.

Das bringst du mit

  • Erfahrung im Performance Marketing: Du hast 3–5 Jahre Erfahrung im Paid- oder Performance-Marketing, idealerweise im B2B- oder SaaS-Umfeld.

  • Offenheit für KI: Du setzt KI selbstverständlich als Unterstützung in deiner Arbeit ein – idealerweise bereits im Paid Marketing.

  • Operative Kanalexpertise: Du arbeitest sicher mit Google Ads und mindestens einer Paid-Social-Plattform wie LinkedIn oder Meta.

  • Sicherheit bei Budget und Kennzahlen: Du kennst dich mit CAC, CPA, ROAS und CPL aus und weißt, wie du Budgets wirkungsvoll steuerst.

  • Analytische Stärke: Attribution, Funnel-Analysen und Reporting-Tools gehören zu deinem Handwerkszeug. Du leitest aus Daten klare Entscheidungen ab.

  • Sprachkenntnisse: Du sprichst fließend Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem oder zweisprachigem Niveau sowie fließend Englisch.

  • Eigeninitiative und Verantwortung: Du kannst den deutschen Markt eigenständig steuern und arbeitest erfolgreich mit einem verteilten, überwiegend in Frankreich ansässigen Team zusammen.


Nice to have

  • Erfahrung in einem Scale-up oder einem anderen stark wachsenden Unternehmen.

  • Kenntnisse des deutschen B2B-, Fintech- oder Buchhaltungsmarkts.

  • Technisches Verständnis für Tracking, etwa Tags, Data Layer und Conversions API, um dich mit Growth Engineering auf Augenhöhe auszutauschen.

  • Französischkenntnisse.

jobs.description:
Channel Partnerships Manager, DACH

About Airwallex

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles to see it in full.

 

As Partnerships Manager, you will be joining as a core member of Airwallex’s Commercial team in EMEA and the first partnerships manager on the ground in Germany. You will be responsible for identifying and building partnerships across our core verticals of travel, SaaS and e-Commerce. We are seeking a strategic, creative, and highly-driven Partnerships Manager who has 5+ years of experience working in a fast-paced or high-growth environment. We operate in a hybrid environment, with a minimum of 3 days a week working in our office in Berlin.

What You'll Be Doing...

  • You will lead, own, and develop a partnership strategy that aligns with our overall GTM in Germany

  • You will be accountable for identifying growth opportunities, testing new verticals, and building a high-quality portfolio of partners

  • You will design a scalable programme to consistently deliver growth in the partnerships channel

  • You will work closely with Marketing, Sales and Strategy teams to position Airwallex’s value proposition to partners and their clients in Germany

  • You will represent Airwallex at industry events and conferences, as well as speak on relevant panels and webinars

What You Bring...

  • Demonstrable interest in fintech, SaaS, and/or payments

  • Strong commercial instincts and a history of meeting or exceeding OKRs/KPIs consistently

  • 5+ years of work experience in partnerships, strategy, business development, or a similar role in a high-growth, fast-paced environment

  • Comfortable working with data and spreadsheets (G-Suite, Looker) and building and delivering presentations for partners and clients

  • Superior verbal and written communication skills in German and English.

Who You Are...

  • Results-driven - you hold yourself accountable for delivering on your targets

  • Proactive - you identify, plan, and execute against opportunities to grow, and you enjoy problem-solving to achieve those goals

  • Laser-focused - you are ruthless in spending time on the highest-impact initiatives in a fast-paced environment

  • Commercially-minded - you enjoy negotiating and you strive to achieve the best outcomes for the business

  • Relationship-oriented - you can build deep and trusting relationships with partners

  • Excellent communicator - you have excellent written and presentation skills

All official communication will come from an @airwallex.com email address. Please apply only through careers.airwallex.com or our official LinkedIn page.

We don’t regard color, religion, race, national origin, sexual orientation, ancestry, citizenship, sex, marital or family status, disability, gender, or any other legally protected status when making our hiring decisions. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

Technical SAP Enterprise Architect (w/m/d)

Als Technical Enterprise Architect bei Westernacher sind Sie strategischer Sparringspartner für unsere Kunden bei der Planung und Umsetzung anspruchsvoller SAP‑S/4HANA‑Transformationen. Sie verbinden architektonische Exzellenz mit methodischem Vorgehen und unterstützen Entscheidungsprozesse auf Managementebene. In enger Zusammenarbeit mit Fachbereichen, IT‑Teams und Presales gestalten Sie nachhaltige, skalierbare Zielarchitekturen und sorgen für eine klare Ausrichtung von Technologie, Prozessen und Organisation.


Ihre Aufgaben
  • Konzeption und Definition von S/4HANA‑Zielarchitekturen (On‑Premises, Private Cloud, RISE with SAP) sowie Ableitung klarer Migrations- und Transformations-Roadmaps.
  • Bewertung und Steuerung von S/4HANA‑Migrationsszenarien (Brownfield, Selective, Greenfield) inklusive Risiko-, Aufwands- und Entscheidungsanalysen.

jobs.title: Co-Founder & CTO | AI & ML Startup
jobs.description:
Co-Founder & CTO | AI & ML Startup

About us

Expertise is the bottleneck in technical field service. We are building the AI that makes it scale – and learns from every visit, from every job.

  • Stealth-mode AI venture building a copilot that guides technicians at every job like an experienced master craftsman – before, during and after every job

  • Built in the field, not behind closed doors: our product is developed with direct access to thousands of technicians with a leading European real estate industry partner – every feature is tested on real jobs, with results in days instead of months

  • Backed by Founders Factory; founding team in Berlin, MVP built and tested with technicians, now heading towards spin-out and first funding

  • Vision: Europe’s leading field service intelligence layer.

The role

We have built and tested our MVP. Now we are looking for a hand-on Co-Founder & CTO who builds the technology and product that grows and scales the company.

What you will do

  • Own the technology end to end: architecture, roadmap, build-vs-buy decisions, reliability and security

  • Take the tested MVP to a production-grade product used daily by technicians in the field

  • Build reliable AI workflows and repeatable integrations into customer systems such as work orders and asset data

  • Continuously improve the Machine Learning core: retrieval over manufacturer and expert knowledge, multimodal input (photo, voice) and diagnostic reasoning

  • Design and build the learning engine that makes the product smarter with every visit: capturing, reviewing, evaluating and reusing confirmed outcomes – the core of our knowledge moat

  • Set up evaluation, safety and monitoring: expert-reviewed benchmark cases, grounding, escalation and regression testing

  • Build a state-of-the-art UX/UI that technicians want to use every day

  • Spend time with technicians in the field and turn their feedback into product within days

  • Recruit and lead the engineering team as we scale

  • Shape the company as a co-founder: strategy, culture and investor conversations alongside the founding team

What you bring

  • Master’s degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning/AI, Data Science, Mathematics, Physics, Electrical Engineering or a related quantitative field

  • Machine Learning experience, ideally 3+ years applying it in production products (e.g. LLMs, retrieval/RAG, NLP, computer vision, model evaluation)

  • Entrepreneurial mindset: you want to build a company, not just a product – full ownership, bias for action and comfort with ambiguity

  • Experience leading the technical build of a product from zero to one, e.g. as tech lead or founding engineer

  • Strong hands-on software engineering across backend, APIs, data pipelines and cloud – you still build and ship yourself

  • Sound technical judgement: you know the limits of LLMs, how to test them and when not to use them

  • Product empathy: you enjoy learning from users in the field and making complex work simple

  • Fluent German and English – German is needed for working with technicians and technical source material

Nice to have

  • PhD in Machine Learning, NLP, Computer Vision, Information Retrieval or a related field

  • Previous founder or early-stage startup experience

  • Experience with Microsoft Azure and enterprise B2B requirements (security, GDPR, multi-tenant SaaS)

  • Background in field service, industrial, maintenance or proptech software

  • Experience with multimodal AI, voice interfaces or decision-support systems

  • Experience hiring and leading engineering teams

What we offer

  • Competitive compensation package, including a meaningful co-founder equity stake

  • A true co-founder role with ownership of the technology and a real say in the direction of the company

  • An unfair head start: a cooperating partner with thousands of technicians and real repair data from day one – the fuel for a system that learns from every job

  • A tested MVP and a clear path to spin-out and funding

  • Support from Founders Factory’s network across tech, design and growth

  • A mission with real-world impact: helping close the skilled-trades gap in Europe

Location & start

  • Berlin / hybrid, flexible

  • Full-time; start as soon as possible

How to apply

  • Send your CV or LinkedIn profile with a short note on why you want to build this company with us and an example of Machine Learning work you have shipped

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
Senior Product Manager

Turn new revenue opportunities into products construction companies pay for.


Your mission

Cosuno is the marketplace where construction companies run their tenders: general contractors invite subcontractors to bid, and subcontractors find and win new projects. More than €100 billion in bid volume has already been tendered on our platform.

We see several ways to grow from here, such as new modules for existing customers or customer segments we don't serve yet. As our Senior PM for Growth, you'll own one of these opportunities and you'll help choose the next. Next to that, you'll take care of the day-to-day product work in your area.

What you'll do

  • Find the real problem. Talk to customers, many of whom aren't tech-savvy, dig into our data and work out who has the problem, how much it matters and what we need to build.

  • Put AI to work. Construction still runs on a lot of manual work. You'll find where AI can replace it and turn that into products customers love.

  • Test before you build. Prototype and run small experiments with real customers before Engineering commits, then ship with Design and Engineering.

  • Bring it to market. Launch with Sales, Marketing and Customer Success, from positioning and pricing to enablement, and measure what it brings in.

After one year, you've taken your first opportunity to real customers, you're working on your second, and the new offerings bring in measurable revenue.

How we work

  • Full ownership. You own your growth opportunity end to end, from the first customer conversation to the revenue it brings in. Design and Engineering build with you.

  • Close to the customer. You'll talk to customers constantly.

  • Fast and data-driven. We ship every two weeks, test ideas before we build them and judge every launch by its numbers.

  • AI-first. We're an AI-first company. AI is at the core of our product, and we work with Claude Code and other AI tools every day. For every opportunity, your first question is: where can AI take manual work off our customers' hands?

What you bring

  • 3–5 years as a product manager in B2B SaaS, and you want to stay hands-on

  • You've taken a new revenue opportunity (a module, upsell, segment or market) from idea to a product customers pay for

  • You've shipped AI features that customers actually use, and you use AI tools every day in your own work

  • You work with numbers and experiments, and you change course when the data says so

  • You explain complex things simply, to a site manager as well as to management

  • German at C2 level and fluent English: our customers work in German, our engineering team in English

  • Experience with two-sided marketplaces, or with construction or another industry that is just going digital.

Why us?

  • Real impact: You own a growth opportunity, with short decision paths to our Head of Product, and you see the result in our numbers.

  • A head start: Your first opportunity is prepared for you, so you can get going from day one.

  • Competitive compensation: A salary above the market average.

  • Work-life balance: Work fully remotely from anywhere in Europe, or from our office in Berlin Kreuzberg.

  • Top-notch equipment: A new MacBook Pro.

  • A great team: Regular company off-sites and team events.

  • Job security: A permanent contract in a stable, well-funded company.

  • Growth & feedback: An open feedback culture with regular 1:1s and development conversations.

About us

Cosuno – Revolutionizing construction through technology.

We are Cosuno – a fast-growing tech startup that is making the construction industry more efficient and transparent with our digital platform for tenders and procurement processes. Our goal: to solve the most complex challenges in the industry with innovation and simplicity.

Artificial intelligence is the key to our solution: it analyzes millions of price data points and helps construction companies create precise and efficient bids. This not only saves our customers time but also helps them avoid unnecessary costs.

But for us, it's not just about technology – it's about the people who drive it. At Cosuno, you will work with creative minds who are reshaping the construction industry. We believe in diversity because we know that the best ideas come from different perspectives. An inclusive work environment is a given for us.

Join us – Build the future of construction.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager (Giftcard)
jobs.description:
Senior Product Manager (Giftcard)

Atolls is the world's largest community-driven shopping platform, active in 20+ markets. 

We help millions make smarter spending decisions across discovery, evaluation, and (re-)purchase by connecting people with the right brands and retailers.

Our 1,000+ team across 10 countries builds products used every day at global scale, where you'll have real ownership and see your impact. Want to shape the destinations people rely on to shop with confidence? Keep reading.

About This Role:

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to take ownership of our Gift Cards vertical - one of the fastest-growing parts of our alternative offers, spanning gift card purchase, redemption, provider partnerships, and cross-market growth across UK, Germany, and Spain.

This is a high-ownership, high-visibility role. You'll set the strategy for a business line generating triple-digit YoY growth in some markets, own the commercial relationships with our gift card providers, and work directly with our Fulfilment leadership on where the vertical goes next. You'll also work closely with - and may grow into ownership of - adjacent parts of our Alternative Offers and in-store rewards portfolio.

We want a strong senior product leader: someone who has built and scaled products at a leading tech company and/or a startup, who thinks and acts like an entrepreneur, and who can move a commercial product forward with minimal hand-holding.

Our Benefits:

At Atolls, we believe in nurturing both your professional and personal growth. Here's what you can expect:

  • A culture that values personal and professional development, with internal mobility opportunities.
  • A supportive and open-minded team that embraces diverse perspectives and innovative ideas.
  • 32 days of paid vacation plus your birthday off, giving you the time you need to recharge.
  • A flexible hybrid working scheme to balance work and life.
  • Access to a learning budget and internal training to help you grow in your role.
  • Mental health coaching to support your well-being.
  • Regular global and local get-togethers to celebrate successes and build connections.
  • The possibility of taking a sabbatical after three years with the company.
  • A cloud-based company setup, providing flexibility and collaboration opportunities no matter where you are.

*These are global benefits that apply to all employees, with additional local perks based on your location.

Responsibilities:

In this role, you will:

  • Own the gift card product strategy and roadmap - from provider selection and inventory quality to the end-to-end purchase, redemption, and admin experience.
  • Lead commercial and provider negotiations - framework agreements, commission structures, SLAs, and multi-entity contracting with gift card providers (e.g. Finperks, Tillo), in partnership with Operations, Legal and Finance.
  • Drive revenue growth across markets - set and deliver GMV and commission targets across France, Germany, and Spain, backed by rigorous transaction-level analysis.
  • Partner cross-functionally - work daily with engineering, design, data, CRM, and adjacent product teams to ship a coherent gift card experience across web, app, and browser extension.
  • Use data to lead, not just report - build and refine models (e.g. fraud-tier scoring), validate revenue and performance data with Finance, and identify the next highest-impact bet.
  • Represent the vertical at the leadership level - bring clear recommendations and trade-offs to cross-team and leadership forums, and help shape Alternative Offers' broader strategic direction.
  • Build for scale - help expand gift cards from a standalone catalogue page into a fully integrated offer type across the platform.

 Your Profile:

  • 5+ years in product management, including significant time owning a product or business line end-to-end at a leading tech company and/or a startup.
  • A strong entrepreneurial track record - you've built something from close to zero, made judgment calls with imperfect data, and taken ownership beyond your formal remit.
  • Commercial fluency - comfortable owning revenue targets, running vendor/partner negotiations, and thinking in margin, commission, and unit economics, not just features.
  • Strong analytical skills - fluent working with transaction and revenue data to make and defend decisions; comfortable partnering with data/finance teams on models like fraud scoring.
  • Proven cross-functional leadership - experience leading engineering, design, and data counterparts in a fast-paced, matrixed environment, without formal authority over them.
  • Excellent stakeholder management - able to influence and present confidently to senior/executive stakeholders.
  • A degree from a top-tier university (e.g. Oxford, Cambridge, LSE, HEC Paris, ESSEC, Sciences Po, Bocconi, ETH Zurich, or equivalent); an MBA or further qualification from a leading program is a plus.
  • Fluent English required

Our hiring process:

  1. TA Call: Meet one of our Talent Experts and get to know Atolls better.
  2. Technical Round: Focus on the technical aspects of the role (Through a Live Case), and meet your potential manager.
  3. Final Round: Meet other Atollians 🏝️
    It varies from 1 to 3 interviews

*Some processes might slightly change according to needs

Ready to apply?

Be part of a destination where your work helps millions of people make better decisions every day. One focused application is all we need. If you truly fit more than one role, you're welcome to apply to up to three. This helps us match you with the right opportunity faster.

We review every application with equal care and will reach out if your profile aligns. Apply now with your CV in English.
*Portfolios, writing samples, or certifications may be requested based on the role.

#LI-PM1

At Atolls, we want to ensure that all employees can thrive in an inclusive environment. Our employment opportunities are open to every gender, race, religion, age, sexual orientation, ability, place of origin, or socioeconomic status. We remain committed to a culture of diversity, equity and belonging, where all employees are welcomed, respected, connected, and engaged. 

As part of our recruitment process at Atolls, we use AI tools for interview recording and transcription. These tools are designed to assist our teams and are never used independently to make hiring decisions. Every assessment and hiring decision is made by our hiring panel and team through human judgment.
Before your first interview, you will receive an email with the option to opt out. You can also change your preference at any time during the recruitment process by using the link in that email or by contacting your Talent Acquisition Partner.

The use of AI, or the choice not to use it, will not affect your application in any way.

jobs.description:
VP, Strategic Operations (UK & EU)

Hims & Hers is the leading health and wellness platform, on a mission to help the world feel great through the power of better health. We are redefining healthcare by putting the customer first and delivering access to care that is affordable, accessible, and personal, from diagnosis to treatment to delivery. No two people are the same, so we provide access to personalized care designed for results. By normalizing health & wellness challenges and innovating on their solutions, we’re making better health outcomes easier to achieve. 

Hims & Hers is a public company, traded on the NYSE under the ticker symbol “HIMS.” To learn more about the brand and offerings, you can visit hims.com/about and hims.com/how-it-works . For information on the company’s outstanding benefits, culture, and its talent-first flexible/remote work approach, see below and visit www.hims.com/careers-professionals.

About the Role:

Hims & Hers is building a global healthcare platform, and we're looking for a VP, Strategic Operations to help power our growth across the UK and Europe.

This senior leadership role will head a team responsible for the strategy and operational work behind all new initiatives across the UK and EU region, whether that's entering a new market, launching a new category or capability, or standing up a strategic partnership. You and your team will take complex operational problems from idea through launch, bringing together the teams, infrastructure, partnerships, and regulatory pathways required to make them real.

You'll work across our global and in-market teams to determine what each opportunity requires, where we can leverage existing capabilities, and where we need to build something new. You'll also own the operational relationships with strategic third-party partners across the region, including pharmacies, labs, and other providers.

This is a role for someone who loves building. You'll need to move comfortably between strategy and execution, bring structure to ambiguity, and drive complex work across teams from idea to reality.

You Will:

  • Lead the Strategic Operations function across the UK and Europe, building the operational capabilities required to support new markets, categories, partnerships, and other growth initiatives.

  • Take new operational capabilities from feasibility through design, build, launch, and stabilization.

  • Develop launch and operational strategies based on business growth priorities, and translate them into executable operating plans across pharmacy, fulfillment, diagnostics, manufacturing, supply chain, and other operational capabilities.

  • Determine where we can leverage Hims & Hers' global operating model and where local regulations, infrastructure, partners, or customer needs require a different approach.

  • Partner with International leadership to assess the operational feasibility, complexity, investment, and sequencing of new growth opportunities.

  • Lead cross-functional execution across Operations, Product, Technology, Legal, Regulatory, Quality, Clinical, and other teams, driving decisions and creating clear ownership along the way.

  • Own the operational relationships with strategic third-party pharmacies, labs, providers, and other partners across the UK and Europe.

  • Evaluate build, buy, and partner decisions and stand up the right operating solutions for each opportunity.

  • Transition mature, owned operations to the appropriate functional or in-market operator once they are stable, while retaining ownership of strategic third-party operating partnerships.

  • Build repeatable approaches that allow us to launch and scale new markets, capabilities, and partnerships faster over time.

  • Build and lead a high-performing Strategic Operations team as our business across the UK and Europe continues to grow.

You Have:

  • 15+ years of experience in operations, strategy, international expansion, or another complex operating environment, including significant leadership experience.

  • Experience in a regulated operating environment. Pharmacy, healthcare, digital health, or diagnostics is strongly preferred.

  • A track record of building something new from the ground up, whether that's a market, category, facility, partnership, product, or operational capability.

  • Experience operating across the UK and/or Europe and navigating differences in regulation, infrastructure, partners, and ways of working across markets.

  • Strong business and operational judgment, with the ability to understand complex problems, identify the decisions that matter, and bring a clear point of view.

  • The ability to move between strategy and execution, from designing an operating model to getting into the details required to make it work.

  • Strong cross-functional leadership skills and a track record of driving outcomes across teams you don't directly manage.

  • Experience building and managing complex external partnerships.

  • A track record of creating structure in ambiguous, fast-moving environments without adding unnecessary bureaucracy.

  • Experience building and leading high-performing teams.

  • German, French, and/or Spanish language skills are a plus.

  • Ability to travel up to 30%, including across the UK, Europe, and the United States.

We are committed to building a workforce that reflects diverse perspectives and prioritizes ethics, wellness, and a strong sense of belonging. If you're excited about this role, we encourage you to apply—even if you're not sure if your background or experience is a perfect match.

jobs.title: Lead Legal Counsel, Regulatory and Financial Services
jobs.description:
Lead Legal Counsel, Regulatory and Financial Services

Are you looking to have an impact on the daily life of millions of entrepreneurs in France (and tomorrow in Europe)?

Are you looking for a work environment that values trust, proactivity, and autonomy?

Then Pennylane is the right place for you !

Our vision

We aim to become the most beloved financial Operating System of French SMEs and Accounting Firms (and soon, European ones).

We help entrepreneurs rid themselves of time-consuming tasks related to accounting and finance while providing them with access to key financial information to assist in making the best decisions for their business.

About us

Pennylane is one of the fastest growing Fintechs in France (and soon to be in Europe!)

In 5 years of existence, we’ve managed to :

💻 Make ourselves known as a groundbreaking accounting and financial software for small businesses and their accountants

💰 Raise a total of €400 millions, including from Sequoia, the famous fund from the Silicon Valley who invested early in companies like Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal and much more...

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Grow from 7 cofounders to 1000 happy Pennylaners : we’re now recognized as one of the greatest places to work in France (and also remotely), with a 4.6/5 rating on Glassdoor.

🌍 Build an international environment with more than 25 nationalities, with a strong remote-friendly culture, where 30% of the employees are already working from all parts of Europe

🤝 Earn the trust of thousands of customers and accounting firms and obtain outstanding ratings

🚀 Already more than 900,000 small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) and over 6000 accounting firms use Pennylane in France!

We are currently operating approximately 30k business accounts under a BaaS model with Swan.

The role of Financial Services in our strategy is set to grow, both in terms of revenue and product contribution, to serve our 800k current customer base.

As such, we are initiating a process to get licensed as Etablissement de paiement et Société de financement. Our ambition is to start onboarding new customers by mid 2027 before starting migrating existing customers.

To meet this ambition, we are starting to hire our Tech, Product, Compliance, Legal and Ops leaders.

We are looking for a Lead Legal Counsel to drive the legal function of our Financial Services activity and build our regulatory legal team.

From the day you join until we are fully licensed, you will structure and execute the legal path to authorization: interpret requirements, translate them into an internal plan, and ensure deliverables are complete, consistent, and aligned across teams. You will help define the target operating model (intra-group and outsourced) and ensure it is legally defensible and well documented for the application.

After licensing, you will shift from “building the file” to running and scaling the legal function of the regulated entity: ensuring ongoing compliance with ACPR expectations, enabling product growth safely, and keeping the operating model (including outsourcing) continuously audit-ready. You will own the legal oversight of day-to-day legal and corporate matters (policies, governance, reporting support, inspections), lead the legal work for launching new regulated products and entering new partnerships, and manage the legal aspects of onboarding and migrating customers to the licensed subsidiary (terms, communications, complaints/conduct risk).

This is a greenfield project with high autonomy and responsibility, and the opportunity to shape the legal culture of a fast-growing fintech while managing and mentoring an experienced Legal Counsel, with the ambition to scale the team further as the business grows.

Organisation & Reporting

You will be part of the core Legal Department. Your reporting line will be Stanislas, our General Counsel.

You will manage a seasoned Legal Counsel and will be responsible for planning the future growth of the Financial Services Legal team. You will also partner closely with our Financial Services Chief Compliance and Risk Officer, Chief Operational Officer and the contract team.

Mission & Objectives

Team Leadership & Structuring

  • You manage, mentor, and develop your team member(s), fostering a high-performance, autonomous, and pragmatic legal culture.

  • You structure the team’s workload and roadmap, delegating effectively while remaining deeply hands-on.

  • You anticipate future hiring needs and actively participate in scaling the regulatory legal team.

Corporate and governance You design, document and run the legal aspects of corporate governance: delegation of powers, board/committee charters, conflicts management, inter-company arrangements on payment services outsourcing, governance narrative for the ACPR reports, and ongoing legal compliance cadence once authorized.

Products, contracts and customer legal architecture

  • You own the legal design of the FS product perimeter (payments services, account services, credit/financing products as applicable).

  • You work with the contractual team (Roland) on the associated contractual framework: customer terms, disclosures, pricing documentation, complaint handling language, and operational/legal flows (including KYC/AML handoffs, incident handling and customer communications).

Outsourcing / BaaS transition & vendor contracting You own legal matters relating to critical outsourcing and third-party reliance (including existing BaaS arrangements): contract negotiation, regulatory outsourcing clauses, audit/access rights, sub-outsourcing controls, exit plans, SLAs, data protection allocation, operational resilience expectations, and documentation suitable for ACPR scrutiny.

Migration readiness In close collaboration with the operation team (Maxime), you lead the legal plan for migrating customers from Swan (sequencing, consent/novation approaches, customer communications from a legal standpoint, continuity of mandates, handling of incidents/complaints, and safeguards to minimise conduct risk).

Privacy and Security In close coordination with our DPO (Léa) and security stakeholders, you ensure that our Financial Services operating model address data processing roles, cross-border flows (if any), retention, incident response, recordkeeping, and contractual protections with key providers.

Regulatory engagement support & internal enablement

  • Until we are fully licenced, you help prepare ACPR interactions (Q&A packs, position papers, meeting preparation).

  • Once authorized, you own the relationship with ACPR from a legal perspective, supporting the CCRO with legal opinions, advisory etc.

  • You train internal stakeholders on the legal/regulatory constraints that shape product and operations, and build a “legal-by-design” approach for Financial Services.

Culture, Training & Advisory You will be expected to operate as an owner, not a “support function,” and to produce pragmatic, regulator-ready outcomes.

About you

  • You have 8+ years of relevant experience, including in-house legal experience at a regulated entity (payments, EMI/PI, bank, lending/consumer credit, factoring, etc.), fintech, or BaaS.

  • You have a proven track record or a strong aptitude for managing, mentoring, and developing team members in a fast-paced environment.

  • You have substantial experience in regulated financial services legal work, and you are comfortable owning cross-functional programmes.

  • Senior legal expert in a French ACPR-regulated entity (établissement de paiement, établissement de crédit, société de financement or similar).

  • Hands on contract experience and knowledge about our regulatory environment (arrêté du 3 novembre 2014, PSD2, DORA, EBA Guidelines, etc).

Skills & mindset

Technical strengths You can credibly lead on :

  • ACPR/European regulatory frameworks for payments and/or lending/financing;

  • Outsourcing and third-party risk legal frameworks in regulated environments;

  • Governance and regulated-entity corporate law basics.

Soft skills

  • Player-coach mentality: capable of executing complex individual contributions while guiding and empowering your team.

  • You can work fast without losing rigour.

  • Strong pedagogy: able to explain complex regulatory legal topics to product managers, engineers and founders in simple, actionable terms.

  • Pragmatic, impact-driven approach, capable of operating under strong regulatory constraints without blocking innovation.

  • Very strong written and oral communication skills in both French and English.

Languages, presence and location

  • Fluent French and English are mandatory.

  • Based in France, with a strong preference for Paris.

  • Regular on-site presence in Paris is expected. Partial remote is possible. This is not a fully remote role.

Recruitment Process

1. Interview with Lucie (30-45 min), Senior Recruiter

2. Interview with Stanislas (1h), Head of Legal, Risk & Compliance

3. Case Study with Stanislas & Maxime (1h)

4. Last round with Laurent and Felix (45 min)

 

What do we do to make your work life easier

🌴 Wherever you are based, you will get 25 vacations days paid by Pennylane

💵 You’ll have a competitive compensation package

📈 You'll get company shares to enjoy a piece of the success story you're building with us

🏡 You’ll have a budget to turn your home into a more comfortable workspace, as well as a monthly allowance to work from a coworking space whenever you feel like it

⛹️ Through our partner Gymlib, you’ll have access to 8000 fitness spaces in Europe and more than 300 activities related to wellness

🇬🇧 You’ll have access to Busuu to perfect your English or your French

💻 You’ll get the latest Apple equipment

🏢 Depending on the teams and the requirements of the position - you'll be able to work remotely from your country of residence, as long as it is in Europe and within a maximum time difference of two hours from the CET time zone

🎉 We are committed to regularly coming together for company events such as Tech Days (which bring remote Pennylaners together every 3 months) or our annual company seminar, fostering significant moments of cohesion for everyone.

 

If you are based in France, you will have a French contract following French regulation on top of the additional perks : 6 to 12 RTT, 5 weeks PTOs, lunch credits (Swile), Alan Blue healthcare cover and regular events in cities where Pennylaners are mostly presents (Lyon, Bordeaux, Nantes…)

We're working on providing those last advantages to our people based outside of France as well, but it can be quite more complex depending on different countries.

 

Who are we looking for ?

To thrive at Pennylane, you need :

-To speak English (level is assessed and appreciated according to the department you’re applying to)

-To be energized by an ever-shifting work environment

-To be highly collaborative (within your team or other stakeholders)

-Sufficiently experienced to prioritize business-led actions on your day to day activity

 

We know that some people are less likely to apply than others, if they don’t feel like they meet the full list of criteria.

If you’re hesitating, we encourage you to apply : who knows, it might be the start of a meaningful and long-lasting collaboration.

 

Important information for candidates

Recruitment scam attempts are on the rise. We invite you to remain vigilant during your exchanges.

Applications through official channels only : apply exclusively through our job postings published on our official platforms (career site, official partner pages).

Always verify the sender's email address: our communications are sent from professional email addresses with the domains ----- or ----- style="min-height:1.5em">We will never ask you for payment or financial information

(bank details, payment for an interview, equipment purchases, etc.) as part of the recruitment process. If such a request is made to you, it is fraudulent. We invite you to not respond and to report it to us immediately.

 

🇫🇷 Données personnelles

Pennylane traite vos données pour gérer votre candidature et évaluer votre adéquation au poste. Si votre candidature n’aboutit pas, vos données peuvent être conservées 2 ans à compter de notre dernier échange ou de la clôture du recrutement afin de constituer & gérer un vivier de candidats. Vous pouvez vous opposer à tout moment et demander la suppression de vos données en écrivant à :
Notre data policy

🇬🇧 Personal Data

Pennylane processes your data to manage your application and assess your suitability for the position. If your application is unsuccessful, your data may be retained for 2 years from our last exchange or the closing of the recruitment process, in order to build and manage a candidate pool. You may object at any time and request the deletion of your data by writing to Learn more

jobs.title: Account Payment Manager
jobs.description:
Account Payment Manager

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Account Payment Manager based in France.

Join a growing international technology environment focused on innovative B2B solutions and payment services for global clients. In this role, you will support the onboarding of payment service providers, electronic money institutions, and banking partners, helping ensure smooth and reliable payment operations. You will coordinate documentation, manage partner communications, and track onboarding processes from initial application through account activation. Working closely with cross-functional teams, you will help resolve operational issues and maintain accurate, well-organized records. This position is ideal for a detail-oriented professional who enjoys structured processes, takes ownership of responsibilities, and thrives in a fast-paced environment. You will also benefit from opportunities to develop your expertise, contribute to operational improvements, and grow within an ambitious international organization.


Accountabilities

  • Payment Partner Onboarding: Coordinate the onboarding of payment service providers (PSPs), electronic money institutions (EMIs), and banking partners, ensuring that all required steps are completed efficiently.

  • Documentation and Compliance Support: Prepare, collect, review, and submit applications, questionnaires, and Know Your Business (KYB) documentation in line with partner requirements.

  • Partner Communication: Maintain regular communication with external partners, follow up on outstanding requests, clarify requirements, and ensure timely progress throughout the onboarding process.

  • Process Tracking: Monitor onboarding statuses, maintain visibility over deadlines and outstanding actions, and proactively address potential delays or bottlenecks.

  • Documentation Management: Maintain accurate, structured, and up-to-date records of onboarding activities, partner information, applications, and supporting documents.

  • Daily Payment Operations: Support routine payment operations and help ensure that payment accounts and related services function smoothly.

  • Operational Issue Resolution: Identify, investigate, and coordinate the resolution of operational issues, escalating complex matters when necessary.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with internal teams to coordinate requirements, resolve dependencies, and facilitate the successful activation of payment accounts and services.

  • Process Improvement: Contribute to more efficient workflows by maintaining consistent procedures, improving task organization, and identifying opportunities to reduce unnecessary manual work.

    • Requirements

    • At least one year of experience in a similar role or a related operational position.

    • Intermediate English proficiency, with the ability to communicate effectively with international partners and handle professional documentation.

    • Experience in fintech, payments, banking, or financial operations is an advantage but not essential.

    • Strong organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple tasks and follow several processes simultaneously.

    • Excellent attention to detail and a structured, process-oriented approach to documentation and administrative work.

    • A high level of responsibility, reliability, and consistency when handling important operational tasks.

    • The ability to work independently, prioritize effectively, and follow through on assignments without constant supervision.

    • Strong written communication and coordination skills, particularly when managing follow-ups and working with external stakeholders.

    • A proactive, results-oriented mindset and the ability to identify issues, take ownership, and seek practical solutions.

    • Comfort with routine but business-critical responsibilities, maintaining accuracy and quality even when handling repetitive tasks.

    • Adaptability and a willingness to learn, improve existing workflows, and collaborate with colleagues across different functions and locations.

      • Benefits

      • Fully Remote Work: Work remotely from a location in Europe, with access to company hubs in Kyiv and Warsaw if preferred.

      • Paid Time Off: 20 working days of paid annual leave, in addition to public holidays and sick leave.

      • Health and Wellbeing: Medical insurance with access to leading clinics and coverage for psychological support through the Pleso platform.

      • Flexible Benefits Budget: A monthly benefits allowance that can be used for personal interests, hobbies, sports, and other eligible activities.

      • Professional Development: An individual learning budget for courses, workshops, and other professional development opportunities.

      • Language Learning: Access to corporate English classes to strengthen communication skills and support international collaboration.

      • Mentoring and Career Growth: Structured career development opportunities, performance reviews, mentoring programs, and training resources.

      • Learning Resources: Access to an online library and a range of learning initiatives tailored to different professional goals.

      • Team Events and Community: Opportunities to participate in workshops, team-building activities, company events, and social initiatives.

      • Collaborative Culture: Join a team that values openness, positive communication, teamwork, initiative, and shared achievements.

      • Modern Work Environment: Benefit from a culture that encourages autonomy, reduces unnecessary bureaucracy, and supports automation to create more time for meaningful work.

      • Career Progression: Grow within an expanding international business that encourages employees to take ownership, develop new skills, and pursue long-term career opportunities.

      • Compensation: Salary details are not specified in the available job description. Compensation expectations can be discussed during the recruitment process.

jobs.title: Certification Engineer
jobs.description:
Certification Engineer

About EH Energy Engineering

EH Energy is developing cutting-edge fuel cell technology for heavy-duty mobility and large-scale stationary power applications. Our uniquely redesigned product delivers a significantly more compact fuel cell system with high power density and lower production costs. In response to the challenges of climate change and the global shift toward decentralized energy, EH Energy provides high-performance, cost-effective fuel cell solutions to our clients and partners.

To support our rapid growth and bring our systems to global markets, we are seeking a Certification Engineer. In this critical role, you will take full ownership of our product compliance roadmap, bridging the gap between innovative engineering and strict global regulations. You will lead hazard and risk assessments, define certification strategies across international markets (EU, North America, marine), and interface directly with notified bodies and classification societies to ensure our fuel cell systems are safe, fully compliant, and market-ready.

This role requires a full-time, on-site presence at our office in Nyon, Switzerland. We are unable to offer remote or hybrid arrangements, so candidates should be based locally or prepared to relocate.

Key responsibilities

Certification strategy and project management

  • Identify applicable directives, regulations, harmonised standards and class rules early in the development cycle and translate them into design requirements (EU, North America, marine)

  • Select and manage notified bodies, NRTLs, classification societies and test laboratories, own budgets, schedules and contracts for certification work

  • Plan and witness type tests, factory acceptance tests (FAT) and site acceptance tests (SAT)

Safety engineering and risk analysis

  • Lead risk assessments to ISO 12100 and hazard studies (HAZID, HAZOP to IEC 61882)

  • Lead design and process FMEA (IEC 60812) for stacks, balance of plant, containers and fuel processing

  • Run explosion-protection assessments: hazardous area classification (IEC 60079-10-1), ventilation and gas detection concepts, and equipment selection

  • Specify and verify safety functions to ISO 13849 (PL) and IEC 61508, including safety requirement specifications and validation reports

Compliance and technical documentation

  • Compile and maintain technical construction files, CE Declarations of Conformity, type-approval dossiers and certification reports

  • Write and review user, installation, operation and maintenance manuals, safety instructions and labelling

  • Maintain the standards register and assess the impact of new or revised standards

  • Manage certification change control: assess design changes for impact on existing certificates

Collaboration and continuous improvement

  • Act as the internal authority on certification scope: ensure in-service conformity of series production with certified designs, and support procurement and supply chain on material and packaging compliance (e.g. RoHS, packaging regulations).

  • Support design reviews and supplier qualification, including component certificates (ATEX, PED, electrical)

Standards and regulatory scope

The role covers, but is not limited to, the frameworks below. Working knowledge of most is expected; deep expertise in several is required

  • IEC 62282 series, CSA/ANSI FC 1:2021, ISO 16110-1 and Machinery Regulation (EU) 2023/1230

Required qualifications

  • Master’s or bachelor’s degree in mechanical, electrical, chemical, process or safety engineering, or equivalent

  • 5+ years in product certification, compliance or safety engineering for complex electromechanical or process equipment (energy, gas, process, machinery or marine)

  • Direct experience with hydrogen or fuel cell systems and the IEC 62282 series, CSA/ANSI FC 1 or ISO 16110

  • Proven track record of taking products through CE marking and third-party certification with notified bodies or NRTLs

  • Hands-on experience leading FMEA, HAZOP and risk assessments, and documenting them to auditor standard

  • Solid knowledge of ATEX / IECEx, hazardous area classification and explosion-protection concepts

  • Experience specifying and validating safety functions to ISO 13849 and/or IEC 61508

  • Excellent technical writing: clear, structured, audit-ready technical files and manuals

  • Fluent English, written and spoken

Preferred qualifications and personal profile

Nice to have

  • Marine type approval with a classification society (DNV, LR, BV, ABS) or IGF Code projects

  • Experience with fuel processing, reformers or fire equipment, and with pressure equipment under PED

  • Certified functional safety qualification or ATEX/IECEx competence certification

  • Familiarity with North American codes (NEC, NFPA) and UL/CSA certification

Personal profile

  • Rigorous and structured, with a strong safety mindset and an eye for detail

  • Pragmatic: finds compliant solutions that keep development moving

  • Confident communicator with engineers, auditors, authorities and customers

  • Self-driven in a fast-growing, scale-up environment; comfortable owning topics end to end

Start date: Immediately

jobs.description:
Digital Campaign/Performance Marketing Specialist

We are the platform turning browsing into shopping. We connect 200 million shoppers with deals they love while boosting local sales for hundreds of top retailers and brands.

We help consumers save time and money while making smart shopping decisions, and we support retailers and brands in engaging customers from online research to in-store purchases.

In 2024, Shopfully joined forces with the North American company Flipp, creating a global leader in the sector. Together, we reach 400 million households and serve over 1,000 top retailers and brands across 27 markets, including Europe, Canada, the USA, Latin America, and Australia.

Ready to spark your growth with us?

WHO WE LOOK FOR

We are looking for a Digital Campaign/Performance Marketing Specialist, who will join our Performance Marketing team.

As a Digital Campaign/Performance Marketing Specialist, you are responsible for the execution and optimization of digital media campaigns within Flipp’s Private Shopper Network and across external platforms. You will ensure campaigns launch with technical precision, monitor external spend daily to prevent pacing issues, and proactively troubleshoot attribution or tracking discrepancies.

To support close collaboration with our Canada-based team & clients operating mostly in Eastern Standard Time, this role will operate on a set schedule of 1:00pm - 10:00pm (Italy local time). We encourage applicants to carefully consider this time alignment as part of their decision to apply. Additionally, please submit your application materials in English.

    • Monitor campaign performance and pacing to identify risks and opportunities.
    • Recommend data-driven optimization strategies based on performance trends and established best practices.

  • Reporting and Troubleshooting
    • Generate and maintain accurate campaign performance reports on a regular cadence.
    • Review performance data to identify trends, anomalies, or delivery risks.

  • Team & Process Improvement

That’s why building a more diverse team, as well as bringing in even more talent, is so important for us.

Senior SAP FICO Consultant (m/f/d)

At Flix, we offer a dynamic work environment with competitive pay, strong growth opportunities, and a tech-driven approach to making travel more accessible, sustainable, and affordable.  

We're looking for an experienced SAP functional Consultant (m/f/d) to join our ERP Finance team at Flix, in Berlin or Munich. 

In the Foundation Division of FlixTech, the ERP Finance team is responsible for the platform that powers our financial backbone: accounting, controlling, procurement, period close, and the integrations that connect them to the rest of Flix. We're setting up a new ERP system for our Train business (FlixTrain) with a first focus on Finance and Procurement. 

As our in-house SAP expert, you'll work closely with our Finance and Procurement teams as well as external partners to make sure the new ERP fits our needs: today and in the long run. After go-live, you'll be the person who owns, evolves and continuously improves the SAP solution from the inside. 

This role is well suited for someone who enjoys ownership, working close to real business problems, and combining solid SAP craftsmanship with a long-term, in-house perspective 

About the Role

  • Act as Flix's in-house SAP expert during the implementation of our new ERP, with a focus on Finance and Procurement. 
  • Translate business requirements from Finance, Procurement and adjacent functions into clean, scalable SAP solutions. 
  • Work closely with external implementation partners during design, build, testing and cut over. 
  • Support data migration, test management, and go-live preparation from a Flix-side ownership perspective. 
  • Take long-term ownership of the SAP solution after go-live: enhancements, change requests, integrations and continuous process improvement. 
  • Contribute to building broader SAP capability within the ERP Finance team thought teaching and mentoring. 
  • Be a trusted advisor to Finance and Procurement stakeholders on what SAP can do for 

About You

  • 7+ years of experience as an SAP Consultant (incl. 5+ years in S/4HANA), with a strong focus on Finance (FI/CO) and Procurement (MM).
  • Hands-on experience with SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud.
  • Additional working knowledge in SAP Supply Chain and Asset Management modules. 
  • At least two full end-to-end SAP implementations, ideally in a company of similar size and complexity to Flix. 
  • Solid understanding of core finance and procurement processes: General Ledger, Accounts Payable / Receivable, Fixed Assets, Controlling, Purchase-to-Pay. 
  • Experience working with external system integrators and the confidence to engage with them as an equal partner. 
  • Comfortable engaging with senior Finance and Procurement stakeholders and translating between business and SAP language. 
  • Structured, pragmatic, delivery-oriented; strong communication and facilitation skills. 
  • Based in Germany, you're fluent in German and English. 

We recognize that everyone carries a unique set of valuable skills and experiences. If you think you could have an impact even though you don't meet 100% of the requirements, we still encourage you to apply. We want to hear from you!  

What We Offer

  • Travel perks: 12 free Flix vouchers + 12 discount vouchers for friends & family. 
  • Work from (M)Anywhere: Depending on your role, work from another location for up to 60 days per year. 
  • Hybrid work model: We are an office-first company, but we offer flexibility to balance work and life. 
  • Wellbeing support: Access confidential 1:1 counselling, courses, and stress management for yourself and up to four family members. 
  • Learning & Development: Take advantage of language classes, training courses, and expert-led sessions to grow your skills. 
  • Mentoring Program: Connect with experienced colleagues to gain insights and accelerate your career. 

To view more local benefits specific to each office location, please check out this link: Locations - Flix Career

Why Join Flix?

At Flix, you'll find teams that rally together to overcome challenges and spark creativity. We believe in ownership culture - giving you the freedom to take initiative, make an impact, and shape your own career path.
As we continue to expand across the globe, you can make a real difference in how we work.

If you're ready to grow and lead your journey, Flix is the place for you!

Senior Growth Marketing Manager (App Installs)

Who We Are

Hi, we're DuckDuckGo, the online protection company and remote-first team of 400+ on a mission to raise the standard of trust online. Founded in 2008 and profitable since 2014, our annual revenue is in the hundreds of millions USD and millions use our browser on Mac, Windows, iOS, and Android, our search engine, and the DuckDuckGo subscription. We also offer private, useful, and optional AI, including Duck.ai, which lets you chat privately with ChatGPT, Claude, and other AIs, all in one place.

 

Our culture of trust, inclusivity, and empowered project management underpins everything we do, where each team member takes full ownership of their projects, from scoping and execution to postmortem. If you're seeking end-to-end ownership of your work, you've come to the right place!

Your Team and Role

Working on the Marketing & Communications Functional Team, you'll manage paid media channels to drive profitable acquisition of new app users, aim to help millions of people take back control of their personal information, and work on related projects. Recent projects include:

  • Scaling and optimizing app acquisition campaigns in Google, Microsoft and Apple ad platforms

  • Launching new ad channel tests and measuring incremental lift

  • Executing in-market tests for new creative and messaging to improve app install conversion

As a Senior Growth Marketing Manager, you'll manage high priority marketing campaigns, including planning, hands-on execution, testing, optimization, and analysis to optimize spend and drive profitable user growth. You'll deliver results from new channel testing, app acquisition, subscriber growth, paid advertising, and creative testing. Responsibilities may also include owning a portfolio of existing channels (Google ads, paid social, app install campaigns) with the goal of efficiently scaling profitable advertising. The right person is excited to prove that paid marketing growth and privacy-respecting advertising practices aren’t at odds — they’re our edge. You know how to use aggregate measurement, experimentation, and strong judgment rather than user-level targeting and tracking.

 

About You

  • 7+ years of experience in digital advertising roles with 2+ years of experience in marketing consumer apps preferred.

  • Hands-on expertise standing up and managing paid digital advertising programs (Google Ads, Apple Ads, etc.) as well as familiarity with non-digital paid media management (CTV, TV, etc.).

  • Demonstrated track record of profitably scaling app install growth programs while improving efficiency and unit economics as volume materially scales.

  • Ability to execute highly complex and ambiguous projects, working across business strategy and marketing tactics.

  • Experience designing and running incrementality tests (geo holdouts, lift studies, PSA/ghost ads) to validate true channel impact and guide investment decisions.

  • Advanced analytical abilities, including modeling app economics (payback, LTV), data analysis, scenario planning, and projecting campaign outcomes across spend and volume curves.

  • Track record of running creative testing as an always on pipeline, consistently shipping new concepts to prevent performance decay and unlock incremental scale.

  • Passion for ideating and problem solving to deliver creative solutions for profitable user growth.

  • Excellent communication skills — you can clearly articulate recommendations and rationale, whether verbal or written.

Eligibility for company-sponsored health benefits is limited to team members based in the United States. This program does not extend to team members located in other countries, such as Canada or the UK.

 

Our Team Member Support Guide explains how we prioritize your wellbeing including paid parental leave, office setup, and co-working allowances.

 

Hiring Process

Hiring works best when it's a two-way street. Learn how we help you get to know DuckDuckGo, envision your future role here, and find out more about how we hire.

 

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

DuckDuckGo provides equal work opportunities to all team members and applicants, and it prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type on the basis of race, color, ethnicity, caste, religion, age, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by our policies or federal, state, or local laws.

 

We want to ensure that our hiring process is accessible. If you need reasonable accommodation for any part of the application process because of a medical condition or disability, please send an email to

 

Please note that

  • You’ll be required to attend meetings on camera via video conferencing

  • Expect to travel at least two times a year: once for our all-hands meetup and again for a team retreat (each around 4-5 days). While extenuating circumstances may impact attendance, everyone is strongly encouraged to attend.

  • While we offer a flexible work arrangement with no core hours, expect an average full-time commitment of 40 hours per week.

  • A successful candidate must pass a background check as a condition of joining the team.

You further acknowledge that providing false or fraudulent information during the application process is cause for denial of an offer, revocation of any existing offer, or other adverse action, up to and including termination after the start of your commencement of work.

 

Disclosure Statement: Use of AI in Hiring Process

We use AI to flag potentially fraudulent applications, analyze and summarize applicants’ experience, interviews, and project performance, and help streamline our selection process.

All final evaluations and hiring decisions, however, will be made by our hiring team, who will consider the AI's input alongside other factors.

TYTAN Technologies

jobs.description:
Talent Partner - Manufacturing and Industrial

Accelerating embodied AGI.

The next ten years of AI will not be won in software. They will be won in the physical world: in factories, hospitals, kitchens, fields, and homes. The companies that own that data will own the century.

microagi is building it. We are a data research and deployment lab. Atlas captures the manual work inside Europe’s industrial champions, trains foundation models on it, and deploys the right robot onto the floor, with no teleoperation and no interruption to the line. Shift records how physical work actually happens and turns it into training-ready data.

We were founded by former Formula 1 engineers from Red Bull Racing and Mercedes, together with a researcher from the Alan Turing Institute. Our $55M seed round, the largest in German history, was led by Hummingbird with Northzone, LocalGlobe, Village Global, and redalpine. We are based in Munich, with our research centre in Zürich and teams in London, New York, and Istanbul. We are now building the engineering and research teams that will take Atlas into new industries.

We're scaling incredibly fast, and our manufacturing capability is central to our future. As our Talent Partner, you'll be focused on hiring workers across the manufacturing lifecycle.

What You Will Do

  • Develop and nurture talent pools across the manufacturing space, such as facilities managers and factory technicians, to ensure consistent delivery across high-volume pipelines.

  • Build a robust employer brand, enabling microagi to be known as a competitive employer in an emerging industrial startup ecosystem.

  • Advise the team on best practices for building out and scaling manufacturing recruiting.

  • Plan and attend industry events to further our market presence amongst the best manufacturing talent.

Requirements

  • 5+ year track record in high-volume blue-collar manufacturing hiring in innovative manufacturing environments

  • Deep network within European manufacturing and industrial talent pools

  • High agency: you don't wait to be told what to do.

  • Fluent in German and English.

Nice to Have

  • Experience working in a fast-paced start-up or scale-up

Who Will Thrive at microagi

Everyone we hire is assessed on the same four traits:

  • Mission and vision: you care about what we are building and why it matters, and your past choices show it.

  • Intensity: you work at a pace that matches the size of the opportunity, and you sustain it.

  • Entrepreneurial: you start things nobody asked for, and you finish them.

  • Raw IQ: you learn fast, reason from first principles, and get sharper when the problem changes.

This is for you if:

  • You would rather own a problem end to end than wait for a spec.

  • You use AI every day, and you can tell a correct answer from a plausible one.

  • You want to work in person, in the office, with people who are very good at what they do.

This is not for you if:

  • You are looking for a predictable 9-to-5.

  • You would forward output you cannot explain.

  • "That’s not my job" feels like a reasonable answer.

How We Hire

We read every application and reply within five working days.

  1. Talent Screen (30 min): a first conversation, both ways.

  2. Technical or Functional Interview (60 min): how you think when the problem changes.

  3. Your Work (60 min): bring something you are proud of and walk us through it.

  4. Leadership (30 min): a conversation with our CEO.

  5. Coworking Day (engineering and research roles): a day building with the team on a real problem.

Then a decision, usually within a few days.

Pay Transparency

Compensation includes base salary and equity. The salary range for this role is shown on this posting.

What We Offer

  • Agency: real ownership from day one, and decisions that actually matter.

  • Freedom: to choose how you solve the problem, without layers of approval.

  • A seat on a rocketship: one of Europe’s fastest-growing deep-tech companies, at the earliest stage.

  • Free food and drinks in the office.

Equal Opportunity

microagi welcomes applications from everyone. We assess candidates on their work and potential, regardless of ethnic origin, gender, religion or belief, disability, age, or sexual identity.

jobs.title: Chief Engineer
jobs.description:
Chief Engineer
Help Build Europe's Hypersonic Capability
 
At Hypersonica, we’re redefining what’s possible in European defence technology. We exist to deliver speed, resilience, and technological independence at a pace that sets a new standard. We are a small, elite team working on problems that matter, and solving them fast.
 
By joining Hypersonica, you’re not stepping into a predefined role. You’re joining a talent dense environment where every individual shapes the direction of the company. Our philosophy is to hire a small number of exceptional people with broad, deep technical capability, strong judgement, and the ability to operate autonomously.
 
We hire for talent, not rigid boxes. This role represents a business need, but the way it evolves will be shaped by the individual. If you’ve achieved what others said was impossible, or you bring a unique combination of skills that doesn’t fit a traditional mould, we want to hear from you. The work you do here directly contributes to Europe’s technological independence.

That is where you come in. 

As Chief Engineer, you will be one of the most important technical leaders at Hypersonica. You will hold the vehicle in your head as a complete system and take responsibility for ensuring that what we design can actually work, integrate, be tested and ultimately fly. 

This is not a role for someone who wants to govern engineering from a distance. You will work directly with exceptional engineers, get deep into difficult technical problems and make consequential decisions with incomplete information. You will challenge assumptions, resolve conflicts between disciplines and keep the overall architecture coherent as the vehicle evolves at pace. 

We hire for talent, not rigid boxes. You may have grown through Systems Engineering, GNC, avionics, flight controls, vehicle design or another deeply technical discipline. What matters is that you have developed the breadth, judgement and technical credibility to make decisions at whole-vehicle level. 

If you have spent your career building systems that people initially thought were too difficult, too ambitious or too fast to deliver, we want to hear from you. 


What you'll do
  • Own the technical integrity of Hypersonica’s flight vehicles from system concept through design, integration, test and flight. 
  • Define and continuously evolve the overall vehicle architecture, ensuring that mission objectives translate into a coherent physical and functional system. 
  • Act as the senior technical authority across vehicle-level engineering decisions, trade-offs, interfaces and risk. 
  • Ensure GNC, avionics, electronics, software, propulsion, aerodynamics, structures, thermal systems, power and payloads work together as a single integrated vehicle. 
  • Drive the definition and decomposition of mission and system requirements, focusing on the requirements that genuinely determine whether the vehicle succeeds. 
  • Own the critical interfaces between systems and resolve technical conflicts when optimisation within one discipline damages performance somewhere else. 
  • Lead major system-level trades around performance, mass, power, thermal constraints, controllability, reliability, manufacturability and operational capability. 
  • Work closely with GNC and avionics teams to ensure sensing, estimation, control, computing, actuation and vehicle dynamics form a robust closed-loop system. 
  • Challenge designs from first principles rather than accepting assumptions because they are conventional or inherited from previous programmes. 
  • Lead technical readiness for major design reviews, integration milestones and flight tests. 
  • Use test and flight data aggressively, turning unexpected behaviour and failures into design improvements rather than paperwork. 
  • Work directly with Manufacturing and AIT to make sure the vehicle being designed can actually be built, integrated, tested and iterated quickly. 
  • Make difficult technical decisions when information is incomplete, balancing engineering rigour with the speed required to deliver breakthrough capability. 

    • Who you are
  • An exceptional multidisciplinary engineer who naturally thinks at system and vehicle level rather than only within a single subsystem. 
  • Deeply technically credible, with a strong foundation in areas such as Systems Engineering, GNC, avionics, flight controls, vehicle architecture or complex aerospace system design. 
  • Experienced taking complex aerospace, defence, space, autonomous or similarly high-consequence systems from concept into real integrated hardware. 
  • Strong in system architecture, requirements, interfaces, integration, verification and technical risk. 
  • Comfortable reasoning about closed-loop vehicle behaviour, including the relationship between vehicle dynamics, sensors, estimation, control, actuators and onboard computing. 
  • Able to understand a difficult technical problem quickly, identify the assumptions that actually matter and drive the team towards an answer. 
  • Experienced making significant engineering trade-offs across multiple disciplines rather than optimising one component in isolation. 
  • Comfortable moving between first-principles technical discussion and major programme-level decisions without losing depth. 
  • Willing to get personally involved when a problem matters. You do not need a large team, perfect information or an established process before you can make progress. 
  • Able to distinguish engineering rigour from engineering bureaucracy. 
  • Confident challenging exceptional specialists in their own disciplines while remaining open enough to change your own mind when the evidence demands it. 
  • Calm when things go wrong, intellectually honest when something is not understood and relentless about finding the real answer. 
  • Motivated by the opportunity to build sovereign European defence capability and comfortable working on systems where the consequences of engineering decisions genuinely matter. 

    • You might have come from

    There is no single route to becoming the right Chief Engineer for Hypersonica. 

    You may currently be a Chief Engineer, Systems Architect, Head of Systems Engineering, GNC Lead, Avionics Lead, Flight Controls Lead, Vehicle Architect or Principal Engineer. 

    You may have spent your career in missiles, high-speed flight, combat aircraft, spacecraft, autonomous systems or another environment where complex physical systems need to work first time. 

    We are less interested in your current title than in the scale of the technical problems you have personally solved. 


    What we offer
  • The opportunity to hold genuine technical ownership of one of Europe’s most ambitious defence engineering programmes. 
  • A company early enough that your decisions will materially shape the vehicles, engineering organisation and technical culture we build. 
  • Direct access to the problem. Short decision paths, minimal bureaucracy and engineers empowered to solve engineering problems. 
  • Daily collaboration with exceptional people across GNC, avionics, propulsion, aerodynamics, structures, manufacturing, test and defence. 
  • The freedom to challenge convention, build from first principles and move quickly when the evidence supports it. 
  • The resources and ambition to attempt things that would take significantly longer in traditional aerospace organisations. 
  • The opportunity to see your decisions move from a whiteboard, into hardware and ultimately into flight. 

    • The person we are looking for

    We are not looking for someone to simply approve other people’s engineering. 

    We are looking for the person engineers turn to when the disciplines disagree, the data is incomplete, the deadline is real and somebody has to understand the whole system well enough to make the call. 

    Someone who can bring clarity to complexity without slowing the organisation down. 

    If that sounds like you, come and build it with us. 

    At Hypersonica, every hire raises the bar. We are deliberately small, intensely capable, and deeply mission-driven. If this role feels like a strong fit, or if you believe you bring something exceptional that goes beyond the description, we encourage you to apply.
     
    Hypersonica is an equal-opportunity employer and assesses candidates solely on merit, capability, and potential.
     
    You can apply directly to this role or reach out to Nathan Sweeney, Head of Talent. We review every application and aim to respond to all candidates within two weeks, whether the answer is yes or no.
