jobs.title: 3D Computer Vision Research Engineer, Geospatial Visual Localization
jobs.description:
3D Computer Vision Research Engineer, Geospatial Visual Localization

About Niantic Spatial

AI has learned from almost everything online, but it still struggles with the physical world, where 99.5% of economic activity happens. It doesn’t know where things are, how spaces fit together, or what changes over time.

That’s one of the biggest unsolved problems in AI, and it’s the one we’re solving at Niantic Spatial. We build spatial AI models and services so people and machines can reason, learn and act safely in the physical world. We turn camera imagery, video, sensor data and archives into accurate, AI-readable representations of real places that robots can train in and machines can use to know exactly where they are.

In physical AI, mistakes have real consequences. That’s why we build AI grounded in measured reality, not guesswork, so the people and machines relying on it can trust it to get things right.

Our team built some of the world’s most widely used maps. Now we’re building something bigger: a living, measured record of the real world that machines can query, learn from and use to understand how places change over time. If you want to help AI understand the world we actually live in, come build with us.

About the Role

We are looking for a Research Engineer to help develop our Geospatial Visual Localization technologies, which allows people and robots to accurately localize themselves anywhere on the planet.

This is an end-to-end applied research role. You will develop new approaches to open problems alongside our researchers in 3D vision and machine learning, and publish your work at leading conferences. You will help build and train large models on large-scale multi-modal datasets, including our proprietary collection of 30 billion posed images and ship them into production, to be used by people and robots from all over the world.

Our team works with heterogeneous captures from phones and other handheld devices, 360 cameras, vehicles, and drones, as well as aerial and satellite imagery, LiDAR, and external geographic data. Your focus will be to improve accuracy and robustness across urban and rural locations, cameras, seasons, weather, and capture quality. The system must remain reliable with noisy GPS, in GPS-denied environments, and with outdated reference maps. Each pose estimate comes with an uncertainty that our customers rely on, and keeping it well calibrated across these conditions is part of the work.

What You'll Do

  • Design, implement, and evaluate novel visual localization algorithms, combining 3D vision and deep learning.

  • Train large models on multi-modal data at scale, and build the benchmarks that measure their accuracy and robustness.

  • Develop robust solutions for difficult real-world conditions: noisy or denied GPS, changing appearance, varying capture quality, large geographic extents, and imperfect reference maps.

  • Work side-by-side with leading researchers in visual localization, 3D computer vision, and mapping, as well as engineering and product teams, to identify the highest-impact problems and turn research into end-to-end solutions that operate at production scale.

  • Communicate results clearly through technical writing, design reviews, internal presentations, and publications.

What You'll Bring

  • Strong grounding in 3D computer vision, deep learning, robotics, photogrammetry, or a closely related field.

  • Demonstrated experience with multi-view geometry and related problems, such as camera pose estimation, monocular depth estimation, SfM, SLAM, georeferencing, point-cloud registration, or sensor fusion.

jobs.title: Chief Technology Officer
jobs.description:
Chief Technology Officer

This role is part of our Prerender team, one of our largest brands at saas.group.

Prerender is a dynamic rendering SaaS platform within the saas.group portfolio. Since 2017, we've revolutionized SEO practices by enabling search engines to crawl JavaScript-heavy sites seamlessly while preserving user experience. Thousands of companies worldwide trust our platform, which serves over 2.7 billion unique pages to web crawlers and drives results for enterprises and growing businesses alike.

Profile Overview

Prerender has built a platform that thousands of companies trust to serve billions of pages to web crawlers. Now we're evolving into something bigger: the layer that makes the web legible to machines, both the search crawlers that have always mattered and the AI systems that increasingly decide what people find.

To get there, we need to transform how we build product. We're looking for a Chief Technology Officer (CTO) to lead that transformation, shifting our engineering organization from infrastructure-optimization to a high-velocity, product-focused team that moves fast and ships features that matter.

This is a building role, not a caretaker role. You'll own the technology vision, set the engineering strategy, and have authority over the R&D budget, team, and technical direction. You'll embed AI-first engineering practices, make smart infrastructure tradeoffs, and build the improvement motion that makes delivery faster and keeps it that way.

You'll lead a small, senior engineering team — around seven engineers today — supported by shared platform and DevOps resources from saas.group's central team. There is no management layer between you and the engineers, which puts you close to the work and means the leadership has to come from you.

So we need someone hands-on enough to augment the team, not to manage it from a distance, and who can do that without losing hold of the strategy and the responsibilities only this role carries.

We need deep technical expertise, a strong infrastructure background, and a proven track record of transforming engineering teams at SaaS companies.

Your responsibilities

Technology Vision and Strategy:

  • Own the technology vision, roadmap, and engineering strategy for Prerender. Align engineering work with business objectives and customer value.
  • Lead adoption of AI-assisted development tooling to multiply team productivity; own the quality bar for what it produces.
  • Drive architecture and infrastructure decisions with a holistic view of TCO that includes maintenance burden and engineering opportunity cost, not just hosting spend.
  • Run a multi-region, Kubernetes-based render fleet efficiently: cost per render, reliability, and the operational hygiene that keeps both from drifting.
  • Represent Prerender's technical capabilities to customers, partners, and the broader market.
  • Maintain high standards of software quality, performance, security, and reliability.
  • Track shifts in technology and engineering practice, and bring the ones that change how we build into the team.

Security and Compliance:

  • Own security and compliance as a standing program. Prerender completes SOC 2 Type II and its ISO 27001 certification decision at the end of 2026; you inherit the year-two observation period, the surveillance audit, and the operational discipline that keeps both credible.
  • Keep the program legible to someone other than you: named owners, current vendor and auditor contacts, and no single point of failure.

Team Management and Growth:

  • Coach and mentor engineers to reach their full potential. Set clear expectations and create opportunities for growth. People matter here.
  • Build a culture of ownership, where engineers carry their decisions through instead of escalating them.
  • Foster diversity and inclusion within the engineering organization.

Execution and Delivery:

  • Own the continuous improvement motion of delivery. The team finds and removes its own bottlenecks on a regular cadence.
  • Enhance DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, and robust monitoring systems.
  • Define and track engineering metrics that matter. Use data to identify bottlenecks and optimize workflows.
  • Manage change deliberately. Changes to practice, process and infrastructure reach the people who have to run them — and, where customers are affected, the customers — with notice, consultation, and a route to raise a question before the change lands.

Executive Partnership and Stakeholder Management:

  • Partner with the CEO and leadership team on company strategy. Communicate technology progress to company leadership and the board.
  • Work closely with Product to align engineering capacity with customer needs.
  • Translate technical concepts for non-technical stakeholders and advocate for investments that drive business growth.

Ownership & Autonomy:

  • Own the full R&D budget including personnel, infrastructure, tooling, and vendor relationships.
  • Run that budget as a managed number. Maintain an infrastructure cost model, report forecast against actual, and be able to say what a decision costs before it's made.
  • Make the right decisions for engineering, aligned with company strategy, without second-guessing or micromanagement.

What You bring to the table

  • 10+ years in software engineering, with 5+ years in senior engineering leadership (VP/Director/CTO) at a SaaS company.
  • Strong infrastructure background with experience running large-scale distributed systems and production Kubernetes, and making strategic tradeoffs between cost, maintenance burden, and engineering velocity. You've driven unit costs down on a fleet you owned.
  • Demonstrated ability to embed AI tooling into engineering workflows and multiply team productivity, with a clear-eyed view of where it helps, where it produces plausible work that doesn't hold up, and how review standards survive the increase in volume.
  • Proven experience coaching, mentoring, and developing engineering teams, ideally through a significant transformation.
  • A track record of raising a team's delivery speed and keeping it raised long after the initial push, with the measurement and process change that made it stick.
  • A record of landing process and platform change that sticks, with the people affected brought along before it landed.
  • Experience owning a security and compliance program in a SaaS company — SOC 2, ISO 27001 or equivalent — as a continuing operational responsibility.
  • Business-oriented and hands-on: you understand how engineering decisions connect to revenue and customer value, and you contribute directly alongside the team, through the same review and planning process as everyone else.
  • Experience with scalable, high-performance web products, CI/CD, DevOps, and security principles. SEO or search-related experience is a plus.
  • Excellent communication skills. Comfortable presenting to boards, working with executives, and collaborating cross-functionally. Communication is async-first in our remote environment, leaning on clear, timely updates with documentation up-to-date and readable and proactive context-sharing.

What’s in it for You

  • Ultimate flexibility: We're 100% remote. Work from wherever you like, whenever you like.
  • Freedom and autonomy: High-trust environment with lots of independence to solve problems your way, with support when you need it.
  • Minimum bureaucracy: We stay efficient and keep momentum sustainable. No death by meetings.
  • Real impact: This is a C-level role with a seat at the executive table, board visibility, and the mandate to transform how we build product.
  • Small & friendly team: We help each other out, have fun, and don't take ourselves too seriously.
  • Our network: Access to a community of SaaS professionals across the saas.group portfolio who regularly exchange ideas and expertise.
  • Flexible time off: Recharge when you need to.
  • Learning Budget: Generous budget for classes, conferences, books, and other learning resources.

Prerender is part of saas.group, and we have a shared goal of succeeding together.

What is saas.group?

Think of us as the driving catalyst behind your favorite software success stories. saas.group, established in 2017, is on a mission to turbocharge promising B2B SaaS ventures, unlocking their full potential. As a Software-as-a-Service portfolio powerhouse, we specialize in acquiring small software treasures and polishing them into industry stars. With a dynamic, fully remote team of nearly 380+ colleagues spanning 50+ countries we are truly global and we are rewriting the playbook on SaaS innovation and collaboration. We grow 25 exciting brands under our umbrella. Feel free to explore our Candidate's Hub to get an insider's view, dive into our culture, gain valuable insights into our teams and how we work.

Also, don’t forget to follow saas.group on LinkedIn to stay up-to-date on our job openings, podcast episodes, and with all things happening at our company.

We don’t just simply offer you to “take a job with us” but rather to “join us on this journey” to build the world's largest platform of independent SaaS companies.

Sounds like something you’re up for? Feel free to apply even if you don’t check all these boxes. We believe in the power of diversity and fresh perspectives to spice up our team. Your application might just be the missing ingredient!

—

saas.group is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace. We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you're passionate about working with a team that values innovation, excellence, and fairness, we encourage you to apply.

We believe in fair and transparent pay. Salary ranges at saas.group are location-adjusted, targeting local market medians for a remote-first environment, and will be shared with our potential future employees in writing before your first interview - so you have everything you need to evaluate the opportunity.

JustPlay is searching for an experienced Senior Product Manager - Ad Traffic Quality to join our team to take ownership of safeguarding our players and protecting our platform’s integrity by designing, implementing, and optimizing innovative systems to detect and prevent fraud across our loyalty gaming ecosystem.

You’ll combine strategic product ownership with a hands-on, data-driven approach to solve emerging issues while building systems and tools that improve detection precision.

Job Responsibilities

  • Define and own ad traffic quality and fraud prevention strategies, identifying risks across ad impressions, onboarding, engagement, and monetisation flows.

  • Develop and deploy real-time detection mechanisms, anomaly analytics, and proactive interventions to mitigate malicious behavior and abuse.

  • Collaborate with data, engineering, and product teams to build robust detection pipelines, alert systems, and responsive workflows.

  • Integrate A/B testing and iterative validation to refine detection models and user intervention flows.

  • Proficient in designing and measuring the impact of A/B tests in risk and fraud scenarios.

  • Skilled at cross-functional collaboration with engineers, analysts, and operations to drive implementation of scalable fraud solutions.

  • Excellent problem-solving mindset, analytical orientation, and strong communication skills.

At JustPlay, you’ll build end-to-end, move fast, and ship work that reaches millions – in a company that’s profitable, built to last, and focused on outcomes over hype.

jobs.description:
Personal Assistant

What we’re all about.

We find, when we come together in the pursuit of excellence, great things happen. And that’s how we do things at Quantexa – together. Our business is data, but our culture is collective. We’re about growth – but not just the bottom line. We create a culture where people feel empowered to do their best work. We might work across continents and time zones, but that doesn’t stop us from collaborating. We’re connected. We celebrate our successes together, and we unite to tackle the challenges.

At Q, we’re looking for people who share that vision. People like you.

The Opportunity

Our part-time Leadership Personal Assistant (PA) to our Executive Committee will be a central point in enabling our Senior Leaders to focus on creating the biggest impact for our clients, our colleagues and our business strategy. This is for a fixed period of 6 months, role, working Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday, and you’ll be office based on all three days.

You’re a brilliant communicator, in writing and in person, with laser-focused attention to detail and a curious, intuitive, agile and practical approach to a busy, varied senior team. You’re a connector, seamlessly making things happen across Quantexa. What makes you Q will help you flourish and enjoy what you do, while being recognized and rewarded with our broad range of benefits.

Our 8 Senior Leaders head up our functions, and our CEO works with his own dedicated PA. You’ll start by supporting 4 of the Senior Leaders, working alongside our current PA. From January, you’ll provide maternity cover, looking after all 8 Senior Leaders until our PA returns from maternity leave in May. Support will be tailored to each leader, from regular day-to-day help to occasional, ad hoc requests.

Our Senior Leaders are used to being self-sufficient, so many of your duties will be cross-functional or project-focused. As you support them, we’ll support you. You’ll report to our Chief Operations Officer, who’ll help you juggle priorities and focus your time on the things that add the most value.

The Senior Leaders are appreciative, hardworking and will value the contribution you bring to making their lives easier. We’re growing fast, and you’ll be an integral part of our journey, with the chance to push the boundaries of what’s possible and make a difference to a lot of people.

What you’ll be doing

  • Acting as the point of contact between our Senior Leaders and internal/external clients, distributing correspondence in an efficient and mindful manner.

  • Creating, drafting and formatting communications for diverse audiences and formats, such as PowerPoint presentations and reports.

  • Planning and coordinating off-sites, meetings and small team events for Senior Leaders and their teams.

  • Planning, coordinating and running annual Board offsite meetings.

  • Attending meetings, taking minutes, delegating actions and managing progress.

  • Managing diaries, scheduling meetings and booking travel.

  • Handling the inevitable last-minute juggling that comes with supporting a team of busy, dedicated senior people.

Requirements

What you’ll bring.

  • Organized and proactive: you juggle multiple projects at once without dropping any balls, take responsibility and create opportunity.

  • Always one step ahead: you embrace change, instinctively know what needs to get done, then make it happen.

  • Excellent communication: you write and speak well for diverse audiences, and you’re creative and detail-focused in getting the message across.

  • Teamwork, one of our core values: you’re a people person who builds strong relationships with colleagues, investors, the board and clients.

  • Customer-focused: you thrive on delivering a great service and making life easier for those you support.

  • Resilient, tenacious and a pleasure to work with, making Q fun wherever you are.

Our mission.

We have one mission. To help businesses grow. To make data easier. And to make the world a better place. We’re not a start-up. Not anymore. But we’ve not been around that long either. What we are is a collection of bright, passionate minds harnessing complexities and helping our clients and their communities. One culture, made of many. Heading in one direction – the future.

It’s all about you.

We want you to feel welcome, valued, and respected - because it’s your individuality and passion that make you Q. We see that, and we celebrate it. That’s why we’re proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer.

We are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse work environment, continuously improving to ensure everyone belongs. Our recruitment process is designed to be inclusive and accessible. If you need any reasonable adjustments or accommodations, please let our Talent Acquisition Team know - we’re happy to assist.

No matter your race, beliefs, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, neurodiversity, or abilities—whoever you are—if you're a passionate, curious, and caring human eager to push the boundaries of what’s possible, we want to hear from you.

Senior Customer Success Engineer

Why join us?

Mitti by SafetyCulture is a global tech company, just not the kind you're picturing. Our almost 1,000-person team builds tools that make work better for the three billion frontline workers who keep the world moving. You’ll be responsible for developing new customer relationships and growing existing ones, from understanding a company’s sustainability goals and business needs to shaping proposals, negotiating agreements and closing deals. Working with senior decision makers and colleagues across SkyNRG, you’ll help customers understand how SAF certificates (SAFc) can form part of their approach to reducing aviation-related emissions.

This is a senior commercial role for someone who enjoys building relationships, navigating complex sales processes and turning customer interest into long-term partnerships. You’ll combine strategic account development with a hands-on approach to progressing opportunities and delivering commercial results.

 

Your responsibilites

  • Win new strategic customers and grow existing partnerships.

  • Build relationships with senior stakeholders and guide them through their SAF journey.

  • Lead commercial opportunities from first conversation through to signed agreement, nurturing the relationship at every stage and ensuring a high-quality customer experience.

  • Develop account and engagement plans for high-priority customers and partners.

  • Create new opportunities through networking, outreach, events, and referrals.

  • Share customer and market insights to help continuously improve our commercial approach and propositions.

  • Management of industry initiatives and client-facing campaigns.

  • Work closely with colleagues across SkyNRG to ensure customers receive a seamless experience.

 

Your profile

We're looking for someone who is commercially sharp, curious by nature, and motivated by helping organisations make meaningful progress towards their sustainability goals.

Must-Haves

  • 8+ years of experience in a consultative B2B business development, sales, or commercial role, preferably within SAF, energy, carbon, or similarly complex or emerging markets.

  • A proven track record of developing new business and converting strategic opportunities into commercial partnerships.

  • Experience building and maintaining relationships with senior stakeholders and decision-makers.

  • Experience leading complex commercial discussions and contract negotiations involving multiple stakeholders.

  • Strong commercial judgment and the ability to balance customer needs with business objectives.

  • Strong analytical skills and attention to detail.

  • Experience working with CRM systems and data-driven business development processes.

  • The ability and motivation to quickly build expertise in SAF, SAF certificates, and the evolving regulatory landscape.

  • A continuous improvement mindset, and willingness to act as an ambassador for SkyNRG and its values: Driven, Genuine, Change-maker

Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience in SAF, aviation, carbon markets or related sectors.

  • Experience working in a scale-up or fast-growing business.

  • Experience with HubSpot.

  • A relevant professional network that can help open doors and create opportunities.

 

About SkyNRG

Since 2009, SkyNRG has been a change maker in the aviation industry. We are dedicated to supplying and producing high-integrity Sustainable Aviation Fuel (SAF), making sustainable aviation a reality.

Collaboration is fundamental to achieving our ambition. We nurture genuine relationships with global partners in our drive to make SAF the alternative to fossil jet fuel.

Our in-house team of SAF experts have helped over 60 airlines and corporates reduce their climate impact using the Book & Claim mechanism; the most transparent and traceable way to support aviation sustainability with real emission reductions.

Sustainability is woven into the fabric of our company. We maintain an independent Sustainability Board, which advises the company on feedstocks and provides strategic guidance on wide-ranging sustainability issues. SkyNRG operations are certified against the RSB EU RED, CORSIA, and Book & Claim standards.

 

At SkyNRG, you’ll find:

  • An innovation-driven culture – where big ideas turn into real impact

  • Growth opportunities – in a fast-scaling, industry-changing company

  • A collaborative team – where your ideas and expertise are valued

  • A mission that matters – leading the change in the energy transition by producing and supplying high-integrity SAF

 

What we offer

We offer a brand-new office in the heart of Amsterdam, designed for collaboration and creativity. Most importantly, you’ll have the opportunity to contribute to a truly game-changing green initiative, making a real impact on the aviation industry and the planet.

Besides that, we offer:

  • 30 paid holidays + 2 for choosing sustainable travel options for your holidays

  • Contribute to a sustainable organization (B Corp)

  • Attractive bonus scheme

  • €5.000,- dedicated budget every 3 years for professional development

  • Commuting travel reimbursement + Lease a Bike plan

  • An office in the city centre of Amsterdam (Nieuwmarkt)

  • Work where it feels best for you: we offer flexible (hybrid in-office) working arrangements

  • Generous employer pension contribution

  • Paid Volunteering Day

  • Access to our electric company boat (also available for private use), free lunch, and lots of social activities – all part of the deal!

 

Is this you?

Are you ready to take the next step in your career with SkyNRG? Explore our vacancies and become part of our company of change makers. Together, we can change the future of flying.

For more information about SkyNRG visit www.skynrg.com.

As an equal opportunity employer, we are dedicated to ensuring every applicant has a fair chance, irrespective of race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, or any other legally protected characteristics.

Waar ga je werken?

Royal Den Hartogh Logistics is een internationale, toonaangevende logistiek dienstverlener voor de chemische, gas-, polymeer- en voedingsmiddelenindustrie. Ons familiebedrijf bestaat al sinds 1920 en heeft veiligheid en duurzaamheid stevig in het DNA verankerd. Met 54 locaties in 27 landen en ruim 2.600 collega's wereldwijd werken we continu aan slimme, toekomstbestendige logistieke oplossingen. jobs.title: Go-To-Market Lead (Germany)
jobs.description:
Go-To-Market Lead (Germany)

About us

Hey there! We're Lleverage, and we're making the Autonomous Back Office actually achievable for businesses. We enable European companies to integrate AI agents into their business, because AI is only useful when it actually fits into daily operations. 

We help the most strategic European industries – manufacturing, logistics, and wholesale – automate the messy, manual processes that most tools can’t handle.

We’re a fast-growing, VC-backed scale-up based in Amsterdam, with big ambitions for 2027 and beyond. This is your chance to join early, have real impact, and grow alongside the company. If that sounds something you want to help build, we'd love to have you on board!

About the role

We're looking for a Go-To-Market Lead to open and lead the German market for Lleverage. This is a senior, hands-on leadership role: you set the strategy for Germany, build the first pipeline yourself, close our first German customers and own the German number. You'll work directly with our founding team, including our CCO, and you'll be the face of Lleverage in Germany.

As the market grows, you'll lead a small German pod. A Go-To-Market Associate will join you to run revops and German-language outreach and calling, and a Forward Deployed Engineer will join once the first deals are signed, to deliver for those customers.

Responsibilities

  • Open and lead the German market: build pipeline from scratch and close our first German customers, focused on mid-size and larger manufacturing, logistics and wholesale companies

  • Own the German number: set targets with the founding team and be accountable for pipeline and revenue in Germany

  • Own the full sales cycle: from first contact to signed contract, including C-level conversations and complex, multi-stakeholder deals

  • Build the German playbook: ICP, German-language messaging, channels and partners

  • Lead the pod: coach the Go-To-Market Associate on pipeline and work with the Forward Deployed Engineer on first deliveries

  • Represent Lleverage: with German customers, partners and at industry events

  • Work directly with the founding team: on strategy, targets, approach and customer feedback

  • Bring insights: from German customers back into product development


What we’re looking for

  • Around 10 years of B2B sales experience, with a strong track record of closing complex deals and hitting targets

  • You have opened a market or built a sales territory from scratch before, and you have taken ownership of a number

  • A senior seller who still loves running deals yourself and is ready to lead a small team as it grows, not a sales executive who manages from a distance

  • You're an excellent relationship builder. You win trust fast, communicate with confidence at all levels, and genuinely enjoy the process of turning a cold conversation into a long-term partnership.

  • You're commercially sharp and consultative. You understand that the best outcomes come from genuinely understanding someone's pain, not pitching a product. You listen well and use data to shape your priorities.

  • You're energised by ambiguity. A new market with no playbook excites you rather than stops you.

  • Native-level German and fluent English

  • Based in Germany, or in the Netherlands

Nice to haves

A network in the German Mittelstand. Experience in B2B sales, partnerships, or business development. Background in SaaS, AI, or Consultancy. Networks in manufacturing, wholesale, distribution or the PE industry. Previous entrepreneurial experience is a big plus, built something, ran something, grew something. 50% of our team are former founders, that tells you something.

Why Lleverage?

Change the world, literally. Traditional industries are sitting on a massive AI opportunity and most of them haven't been reached yet. You'll be the one opening those doors.

Work, learn, have fun. We're building one of the strongest commercial teams in Europe. You'll work directly with the founding team, surrounded by exceptional talent, and genuinely enjoy the people around you.

Build a unique network. Lleverage is a global top AI brand. You'll connect with industry leaders and some of the most important operators in tech and traditional industry.

Get autonomy and ownership. You design the approach, build the relationships, own the results, and grow with the company.

Compensation. Competitive salary depending on experience, strong bonus structure (fi we win you win), and an excellent share package that makes this genuinely worth betting on.

jobs.title: Senior R&D Engineer Trainingssystemen (m/v/x)
jobs.description:
Senior R&D Engineer Trainingssystemen (m/v/x)

Ben jij een ervaren bèta-academische professional die klaar is voor een nieuwe uitdaging? Wil je bijdragen aan de ontwikkeling van 's werelds meest innovatieve simulatie- en trainingssystemen binnen de militaire (en civiele) luchtvaartwereld? Wil jij je technische kennis en ervaring inzetten voor het initiëren en realiseren van complexe, multidisciplinaire projecten in een high-tech omgeving? Dan zijn wij op zoek naar jou!

Wat ga je doen?

Als senior R&D Engineer Trainingssystemen richt je je op het initiëren en realiseren van innovatieve, multidisciplinaire ontwikkelingen en het opzetten, uitvoeren en managen van grote, complexe projecten. Een belangrijk onderdeel van deze functie is het optreden als Subject Matter Expert (SME) in je vakgebied, waarbij je je kennis en expertise deelt met collega's, klanten adviseert en bijdraagt aan de ontwikkeling van innovatieve oplossingen. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor het leiden van projectteams, het adviseren van klanten en het opbouwen en onderhouden van een extern nationaal en internationaal relatienetwerk.

Je takenpakket omvat onder andere:

  • Het initiëren en realiseren van innovatieve, multidisciplinaire ontwikkelingen, waaronder het genereren van ideeën voor nieuwe technologische ontwikkelingen en het realiseren van samenwerking met andere disciplines;

  • Het opzetten, uitvoeren en managen van grote, complexe projecten, waaronder het uitwerken van projectplannen, het inventariseren en analyseren van projectrisico's en het adviseren van klanten over alternatieven;

  • Het leiden van projectteams, waaronder het geven van leiding aan projectmedewerkers, het bewaken van de voortgang en resultaten van de projecten en het zorgen voor de kwaliteit van de uitvoering;

  • Het opbouwen en onderhouden van een extern nationaal en  internationaal relatienetwerk, waaronder het initiëren en onderhouden van samenwerkingsverbanden, het creëren van mogelijkheden en het uitbrengen van proposals;

  • Het adviseren van klanten, waaronder het opbouwen van een zodanige relatie met de klant dat de klant kan worden ondersteund bij een verscheidenheid aan vraagstukken en het geven van advies over alternatieven;

  • Het bijdragen aan de ontwikkeling van afdelingsbeleid, waaronder het realiseren van innovatieve, multidisciplinaire ontwikkelingen en het adviseren van afdelingsmanagement en businessmanager.

Je werkt samen met collega's uit andere teams aan diverse soorten projecten die hoogwaardige technologische simulatie- en trainingsoplossingen leveren aan eindgebruikers in de luchtvaartoperatie. Je hebt frequent contact en interactieve werksessies met hen om tot grensverleggende totaaloplossingen te kunnen komen.

Jouw enthousiasme en de wil om je te verdiepen in de operationele wereld van deze gebruikers is daarbij een must. Dat doe je niet enkel vanaf je bureau maar ook bij de operationele gebruikers op locatie, en regelmatig samen met industrie en kennispartners wereldwijd!

Wat breng je mee?

  • Een afgeronde WO-opleiding in Informatica, Lucht- en Ruimtevaarttechniek, Technische Natuurkunde, Werktuigbouwkunde of vergelijkbare studierichting;

  • Ruime (>10 jaar) werkervaring in een technische of wetenschappelijke discipline, met een focus op simulatie, training of een verwant gebied, zoals luchtvaart, ruimtevaart, defensie of andere industrieën waarin complexe systemen en processen worden gesimuleerd. Sterke affiniteit en ervaring in het militaire domein is een pre;

  • Affiniteit met innovatieve M&S technologie, zoals real-time simulatie technologie, AR/VR/MR, IoT, data- en softwarearchitecturen en netwerken;

  • Interesse of ervaring in het verbinden van systemen en het waarborgen van interoperabiliteit, bijvoorbeeld door het werken met netwerkprotocollen of architecturen;

  • Kennis van softwareontwikkeling (zowel de implementatie als procesmatig);

  • Uitstekende communicatieve vaardigheden, in de Nederlandse en Engelse taal;

  • Ervaring met projectmanagement, leidinggeven aan projectteams en het schrijven van proposals.

Wat bieden wij jou?

Werken bij NLR, betekent werken in een nationale en internationale hightech omgeving. Samenwerken en betrokkenheid staan bij ons hoog in vaandel. Door jou vrijheid en eigen verantwoordelijkheid te geven, ben jij het best in staat om tot baanbrekende innovaties te komen. Wil jij jezelf vakinhoudelijk én op persoonlijk vlak ontwikkelen? Ook dat kan bij NLR als lerende organisatie, met daarnaast een opleidingsbudget, een mentor, interne coaches en goede contacten met mbo’s, hbo’s en universiteiten.

Naast dit alles bieden wij jou:

  • Een bruto maandsalaris tussen € 5400 en €7100 (op basis van een 40-urige werkweek), afhankelijk van je kennis en ervaring;

  • 45 verlofdagen (op basis van een 40-urige werkweek);

  • 8% vakantiegeld én een vaste eindejaarsuitkering van 8%;

  • De kosten voor reizen met het openbaar vervoer worden volledig vergoed. Reis je met eigen vervoer? Dan ontvang je een kilometervergoeding voor woon-werkverkeer.

  • Een tegemoetkoming in jouw zorgkosten;

  • Extra betaald ouderschapsverlof;

  • De mogelijkheid om jezelf te ontwikkelen met opleidingen en cursussen die passen bij jouw ambities.

Jouw nieuwe werkomgeving

Bij de afdeling Training & Simulatie werken experts op het gebied van simulatie, informatica, opleiding en training, kunstmatige intelligentie, psychologie, en lucht- en ruimtevaart. Het team waarin je terecht komt is het team Trainingssystemen. We zijn expert op het gebied van de volledige life-cycle van simulatiemiddelen – van verwerving, tot ontwerp en ontwikkeling, tot VV&A en kwalificatie, tot uiteindelijke operatie – gedreven vanuit een diepgaande kennis van M&S-technologie en –gebruik in combinatie met operationele expertise en klantdomeinkennis. De afdeling beschikt over onderzoeksfaciliteiten zoals een Battle Lab en een laboratorium dat zich richt op AR/VR innovaties. De sfeer binnen de afdeling is informeel en collegiaal en we vinden het belangrijk dat iedereen zich thuis kan voelen bij ons!

Wat betekent werken bij NLR?

Koninklijke NLR is al ruim 100 jaar een kennisorganisatie met de wil en ambitie om te vernieuwen. Vanuit die drijfveer maken wij de wereld van lucht- en ruimtevaart veiliger, duurzamer, efficiënter en effectiever en staan wij voor baanbrekende innovaties.

Bij ons werken meer dan 1000 gedreven professionals, van vliegtuigbouwkundigen tot psychologen en van wiskundigen tot applicatiedeskundigen. NLR staat voor een inclusieve en diverse organisatie waar iedereen zich welkom, veilig, gewaardeerd en gerespecteerd voelt.

Wil jij meer weten?

Bel of mail dan met Pien Moller (recruiter) via 0611443915 of Onze collega’s vertellen jou graag hoe het is om bij NLR te werken. Vergeet trouwens ook niet eens een kijkje op onze socials te nemen zoals ons YouTube kanaal.

Solliciteren?

Mooi, we zijn benieuwd naar jou! Stuur je motivatiebrief en CV via de ‘Solliciteren’ button.

 

Een positieve uitkomst van een veiligheidsonderzoek (VGB) is een voorwaarde voor indiensttreding. Meer informatie daarover lees je op de website van de MIVD.

Acquisitie wordt niet op prijs gesteld!

Front End Developer

Job Title: Front-End Developer
Location: Fully Remote (US)
Department: Global Enrollment Marketing and Sales
Reports to: Director of Web Development
Classification: Regular, Full-time
FLSA Status: Exempt
Prepared by: Global Head of Creative
Prepared Date: 10/1/26
Salary range:Â $85,000â$100,000


About Edconic

Edconic is a leading player in the alternative, experiential education space. We partner with the world's largest and most well-known brands to create and run schools that capture the legacy and value of each brand. Our students get truly unique, once-in-a-lifetime experiences that help shape their future and give them the skills they need to reach their goals.

The Role

We're looking for an experienced Front-End Developer to join our web team, which owns every Edconic digital property â from our school websites to landing pages and email templates. You'll work alongside designers, IT, and MarTech to build solutions that serve real business needs while protecting each brand's unique identity.

You'll be one of two developers on the team, working directly with our lead developer. That means real ownership of your work, a genuine voice in how we build, very little process overhead, and a codebase that is actively moving toward a modern, standardized WordPress stack. We value craft: fast pages and code that the next developer can read.

What You'll Do

  • Build and maintain public-facing websites, micro-sites, and landing pages in collaboration with our lead developer, IT, and MarTech.
  • Work with UX/UI designers to confirm the technical feasibility of designs, then translate them into polished, responsive pages that stay true to each brand.
  • Build and maintain custom WordPress themes across both of our stacks: modern block-based builds (ACF Blocks, core blocks, block patterns, theme.json) and established classic themes built on PHP templates, Advanced Custom Fields, and Sass.
  • Collaborate with our lead developer to shape the team's coding standards, tooling, and workflow, and help migrate our existing sites toward our new modern stack.
  • Stay current on emerging web standards and bring ideas to the table where they genuinely fit.

What You Bring

  • 4+ years of front-end web development experience, with strong skills in semantic HTML, CSS, JavaScript, PHP, and WordPress.
  • The ability to build a custom WordPress theme from scratch using PHP templates and Advanced Custom Fields.
  • Strong CSS skills across Sass and modern native CSS (custom properties, nesting), and solid vanilla JavaScript.
  • Comfort working in Git/GitHub with pull requests and code reviews, and with npm-based build tools and the command line.
  • A habit of writing semantic, well-structured HTML that covers accessibility basics, with an eye for reuse, cross-browser compatibility, performance, and SEO.
  • Experience building and testing HTML emails.
  • Strong UX/UI sensibilities and a desire to sweat the small stuff.
  • A proactive, self-directed working style â you can run with a project independently and prioritize across several at once.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication â you're positive, collaborative, objective, and solution-oriented.

Bonus Experience

  • Modern WordPress block development: ACF Blocks, block.json, theme.json, and block patterns.
  • Composer, Bedrock or other Roots tooling (Sage/Blade, Trellis), Vite, or CI/CD with GitHub Actions.
  • Deeper accessibility experience (WCAG, ARIA, assistive-technology testing).
  • CRM and marketing automation integration (Salesforce, Pardot/Account Engagement).
  • Multilingual WordPress sites.
  • A modern JavaScript framework such as React or Vue.
  • UX or UI design, and design tools such as Figma and Adobe Creative Suite.


How We Use AI

AI-assisted development is a new and evolving part of our workflow. We use AI coding tools to speed up research, scaffolding, review, and routine work, and you're welcome to do the same.

AI is a tool here, not a substitute for expertise. You are accountable for every line of code that you ship, which means you must be able to write, review, debug, and explain production code entirely on your own. Expect to demonstrate those skills without AI assistance during the interview process.

Location, Travel & Eligibility

  • Fully remote within the United States. Occasional travel to our New York office may be required.
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the US.
  • Bachelor's degree preferred (Computer Science, Interaction Design, Graphic Design, Communications, or a related field); equivalent professional experience is equally welcome.

Our Commitment

Edconic supports and embraces diversity and inclusiveness, and we encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply, even if you don't meet every requirement listed here. Reasonable accommodations are available to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the role and to participate in the interview process.

The above statements describe the general nature and level of work for this position. They are not an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, and skills. Edconic reserves the right to modify this job description at its sole discretion.

jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer II, AI Native, Vertical Experiences
jobs.description:
Senior Backend Engineer II, AI Native, Vertical Experiences

About Life360

Life360's mission is to keep people close to the ones they love. Our category-leading mobile app, Tile tracking devices, and Pet GPS tracker empower members to protect the people, pets, and things they care about most with a range of services, including location sharing, safe driver reports, and crash detection with emergency dispatch. Life360 serves approximately 102.4 million monthly active users (MAU), as of June 30, 2026, across more than 180 countries.

Life360 delivers peace of mind and enhances everyday family life with seamless coordination for all the moments that matter, big and small. By continuing to innovate and deliver for our customers, we have become a household name and the must-have mobile-based membership for families (and those friends who are basically family).

Life360 has more than 500 (and growing!) remote-first employees. For more information, please visit life360.com.

Life360 is a Remote-First company, which means a remote work environment will be the primary experience for all employees. All positions, unless otherwise specified, can be performed remotely (within the US and Canada) regardless of any specified location above.

We are AI Native

We are building an AI native company where AI is an integral part of how we build and operate. AI tool usage during interviews varies by role. You may be asked to demonstrate proficiency with AI tools, discuss how you leverage AI, or complete interview exercises without AI assistance. Your Recruiter will provide clear guidance as you move through the interview process.

Undisclosed use of AI not previously discussed with or approved by your Recruiter may impact your candidacy.

About The Team

The Vertical Experiences team builds the experiences that bring pets into the family — pet profiles, activity timelines, care coordination, lost pet alerts, and third-party integrations. We sit within Life360's Devices org, but our work is squarely in the consumer product layer: building experiences that help families care for, track, and stay connected to their pets. We ship frequently, own our features end to end, and work closely with mobile, design, and product to define what pet ownership looks like inside Life360.

We are an AI-Native team. AI isn't an add-on to how we work — it's how we work. We've redesigned our development workflows around AI, using it as a first-class collaborator at every stage: spec writing, code generation, test authoring, incident triage, and system design. We ship faster and go deeper because of it. We're looking for engineers who want to help define what AI-native development looks like for a high-traffic consumer product.

About the Job

As a Backend Engineer on the Vertical Experiences (Devices Cloud) team, you’ll build and operate the cloud services that power Life360’s connected devices. This role sits at the intersection of hardware, firmware, and mobile, translating real-world device signals into reliable, scalable backend systems. You’ll work on high-throughput, low-latency services that manage device state, ingest telemetry, and enable new device-driven features for millions of members worldwide. The work is hands-on, systems-oriented, and designed for engineers who enjoy solving messy, real-world problems at scale.

You don't just use AI tools. You think natively in them. Your primary workflow involves orchestrating agents to create specs, generate code and tests, verify results, and perform reviews. You'll help establish and evolve AI-native engineering practices for the Vertical Experiences team while delivering features that ship to production weekly.

For candidates based in the US, the salary range for this position is $148,000 to $216,000 USD. For candidates based out of Canada, the salary range for this position is $171,500 to $201,000 CAD. Note: Please be aware that the job title for positions in Canada will be "Developer" in lieu of "Engineer." We take into consideration an individual's background, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience in determining final salary. Base pay may also vary based on geographic location, with US work locations falling into one of three geographic tiers.

Total compensation is inclusive of equity compensation in the form of Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), as well as a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, financial, and other benefits.

What You'll Do

  • Design, build, and maintain backend services that support device connectivity, telemetry ingest, health monitoring, and command/control operations.
  • Collaborate with firmware, mobile, and product teams to define APIs and workflows for device features.
  • Deliver scalable, resilient systems in a microservices environment running on AWS (EKS, Lambda, DynamoDB, SQS, etc.).
  • Build and own data pipelines for high-throughput streams using Kafka or similar streaming tech.
  • Instrument services for observability, reliability, and SLO compliance.
  • Participate in on-call rotations and live incident response.
  • Write clean, testable, performant code and help improve CI/CD and automation.
  • Orchestrate AI coding agents daily for spec writing, code generation, test authoring, incident triage, PR review, and system design

What We’re Looking For

  • Bachelor’s in Computer Science or equivalent experience.
  • 5+ years experience building backend services in Java, Go, Python, or similar languages.
  • Experience with microservices architecture, RESTful API design, and distributed systems.
  • Strong skills with cloud infrastructure (AWS preferred), container orchestration, and deployments.
  • Experience with databases (relational and/or NoSQL), caching layers, and event/streaming systems.
  • Comfortable collaborating across teams and articulating technical tradeoffs.
  • Hands-on agentic AI workflow experience.

Nice-to-Have

  • Experience with IoT or telematics systems.
  • Familiarity with Kafka, Kinesis, or other streaming platforms.
  • Experience with high-frequency ingest systems and time-series data.
    A background with observability tooling (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry).
  • Knowledge of SRE practices and automated testing frameworks.

AI-Native Expectations

We use AI coding tools as a professional standard on this team. Here's what that means in practice:

  • Daily use: You use AI coding assistants (we support Claude Code, Cursor, and GitHub Copilot) for real, substantive tasks: analysis, coding, refactoring, testing, navigating codebases, and documentation. Not just research or autocomplete.
  • Judgment and ownership: AI-generated code gets the same review you'd give any PR. You are accountable for everything you ship.
  • Velocity: We expect senior engineers who use AI well to operate with meaningful leverage — doing more with the same time, taking on problems that would otherwise require a larger team.
  • Team leadership: You share what works. You automate prompting strategies that others can build on.
  • Continuous learning: The tooling is changing fast. You stay current and bring recommendations to the team.

Our Benefits

  • Competitive pay and benefits.
  • Medical, dental, vision, life and disability insurance plans (100% paid for US employees). We offer supplemental plans for medical and dental for Canadian employees.
  • Paid parental leave.
  • 401(k) plan with company matching program in the US and RRSP with DPSP plan for Canadian employees.
  • Mental Wellness Program & EAP.
  • Flexible PTO and 12 company-wide days off throughout the year.
  • Learning & Development programs.
  • Equipment, tools, and reimbursement support for a productive remote environment.
  • Free Life360 Platinum Membership for your preferred circle.
  • Free Tile Products.

Life360 Values

Our company’s mission-driven culture is guided by our shared values to create a trusted work environment where you can bring your authentic self to work and make a positive difference.

  • Be a Good Person — We have a team of high integrity people you can trust.
  • Be Direct With Respect — We communicate directly, even when it’s hard.
  • Members Before Metrics — We focus on building an exceptional experience for families.
  • High Intensity, High Impact — We do whatever it takes to get the job done.

Our Commitment to Diversity

We believe that different ideas, perspectives and backgrounds create a stronger and more creative work environment that delivers better results. Together, we continue to build an inclusive culture that encourages, supports, and celebrates the diverse voices of our employees. It fuels our innovation and connects us closer to our customers and the communities we serve. We strive to create a workplace that reflects the communities we serve and where everyone feels empowered to bring their authentic best selves to work.

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at Life360. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or any legally protected status.

We encourage people of all backgrounds to apply. We believe that a diversity of perspectives and experiences create a foundation for the best ideas. Come join us in building something meaningful. Even if you don’t meet 100% of the above qualifications, you should still seriously consider applying!

Software Engineer New Grad, Machine Learning Platform - Quora

[Quora is a privately held, "remote-first" company. This position can be performed remotely from anywhere in Canada or the United States. Please visit careers.quora.com/eligible-countries for details regarding employment eligibility by country.]

About Quora:

Quora’s mission is to grow the world's collective intelligence. To do so, we have two platforms:

  • Quora: a global knowledge sharing platform with millions of monthly unique visitors, bringing people together to share insights on various topics and providing a unique platform to learn and connect with others.

  • Poe: a cloud workspace where millions of users run multiple AI agents on shared context and tools. One subscription, every frontier model, and the collaboration layer that makes them work together.

Behind these products are passionate, collaborative, and high-performing global teams. We have a culture rooted in transparency, idea-sharing, and experimentation that allows us to celebrate success and grow together through meaningful work. Join us on this journey to create a positive impact and make a significant change in the world.

This role will be working on our Quora product.

About the Team and Role:

Machine Learning is central to Quora's mission of growing the world's collective intelligence. We have 100+ Machine Learning models in production powering various product features. We use a variety of algorithms — everything from linear models to decision trees and deep neural networks. Our production models operate at a huge scale, serving hundreds of millions of people using Quora every month.

Our team owns Quora's ML platform and ranking infrastructure across four areas: serving reliability, ML engineer enablement and developer velocity, business impact, and cost efficiency. We want to empower all ML engineers at Quora to be as impactful as they can be in solving different ML problems at scale.

As a Software Engineer (New Grad) on this team, you'll work at the intersection of machine learning, distributed systems, and GPU serving performance — and your work will have an enormous impact on Quora's long-term success.

No previous ML infrastructure experience is required for this role. You'll be joining a team of senior and staff engineers, learning this stack from the people who built it, with a dedicated mentor and strong technical guidance — and you'll be shipping to production in your first few weeks.

Stack: Python, Go, C++, PyTorch, Kubernetes/EKS, NVIDIA Triton, Ray, AWS

Excited to see our MLP team's amazing work in action? Check out some of the incredible projects they've completed below! ✨
- https://quoraengineering.quora.com/Migrating-from-x86-to-AWS-Graviton-A-Journey-in-Cost-Optimization-and-Performance

- https://quoraengineering.quora.com/Building-Embedding-Search-at-Quora

Responsibilities:

  • Help build and maintain the core infrastructure that powers Quora's ML platform, ensuring high availability, scalability, and performance

  • Build and improve the distributed systems that serve our ML models in production, from Large Recommendation Models (LRMs) to Large Language Models (LLMs)

  • Work on GPU model serving, optimizing latency, throughput, and cost to support larger and more capable models

  • Contribute to platform initiatives such as PyTorch-first standardization and ML ecosystem modernization

  • Improve ML developer velocity by building tooling that helps ML engineers develop, test, and deploy models more efficiently

  • Modernize our feature store so ML engineers can get new features into production faster

  • Participate in the team's on-call rotation, helping resolve production issues as you grow your knowledge and ownership of the platform

Minimum Requirements:

  • Availability for meetings and impromptu communication during Quora's "coordination hours" (Mon-Fri: 9am-3pm Pacific Time)

  • A 2025 or 2026 graduate with or pursuing a B.S., M.S., or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field

  • Genuine interest in large-scale distributed systems, infrastructure, and machine learning

  • Knowledge of Python, Go, or C++, or the ability to learn them quickly

  • A passion for learning and always improving yourself and the team around you

Preferred Requirements:

  • Previous software engineering experience via an internship, work experience, open-source contribution, or coding competition

  • Coursework or hands-on experience with ML frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow

  • Exposure to Kubernetes, Docker, or cloud technologies like AWS

  • Experience with low-level performance work of any kind: profiling, benchmarking, optimization

  • Passion for Quora's mission and goals

jobs.title: Principal Analyst, Data Integration
jobs.description:
Principal Analyst, Data Integration
At H1, we believe access to the best healthcare information is a basic human right. Our mission is to provide a platform that can optimally inform every doctor interaction globally. This promotes health equity and builds needed trust in healthcare systems. To accomplish this our teams harness the power of data and AI-technology to unlock groundbreaking medical insights and convert those insights into action that result in optimal patient outcomes and accelerates an equitable and inclusive drug development lifecycle. Visit h1.co to learn more about us.
 
The Data & Research team is responsible for the end-to-end lifecycle of H1's data — from source acquisition and onboarding through normalization, entity resolution, and product delivery. Working closely with Engineering, Product, and client-facing teams, this group ensures that every data source H1 adds is evaluated rigorously, integrated accurately, and delivered in a way that creates real value for the healthcare and life sciences organizations that rely on our platform.
 
WHAT YOU'LL DO AT H1

As a Principal Analyst, Data Integration, you will own the end-to-end process of evaluating, scoping, and onboarding new data sources into H1's platform. This is a senior IC role at the intersection of data, engineering, and product — the connective tissue between raw data acquisition and what ultimately ships to clients. You will work across Data & Research, Engineering, and Product to define what a new source is, how it maps to H1's schemas, what it can realistically deliver, and what it can't. You will also work directly with client-facing teams to gather requirements before integration decisions are made, translating commercial needs into data specs and data constraints back into product expectations.

You will:
- Lead structured evaluation of new data sources from scratch — assessing schema, coverage, freshness, legal constraints, and fit against H1's product needs before any engineering work begins
- Own field mapping from source to H1's bronze/silver/gold layers, producing data dictionaries, entity definitions, and structural guidance for downstream teams
- Partner with engineering and Data Lake to define ingestion requirements, entity resolution rules, and refresh cadences for new sources
- Gather requirements from client-facing teams and translate them into integration specifications; serve as the authoritative voice on what a new source can and cannot deliver before product commitments are made
- Shepherd each source end-to-end: scoping → QA → entity matching → product launch, including product QA and communicating source capabilities and limitations to product and enablement partners
- Work with the Insights team to develop new taxonomies and QA mechanisms for novel data types
- Define acceptance criteria and lead QA validation including field-level fill rates, count comparisons, and cycle-over-cycle anomaly detection
- Investigate and resolve data quality issues post-integration, coordinating with DART and engineering as needed
- Hand off to the maintaining team with complete mapping documentation; you own onboarding, not ongoing maintenance
- Produce and maintain documentation other people actually use — across scoping assessments, field mapping specs, and post-mortems

ABOUT YOU
You are a senior data professional who has personally owned the full lifecycle of a data integration — not just contributed to one. You are comfortable working across ambiguous, novel data structures and can ramp quickly on new source types each quarter. You operate with strong judgment about where integration risk lives, and you communicate clearly to both technical partners and client-facing stakeholders about what data can and cannot do.
 
REQUIREMENTS
- 8–12+ years in data-focused roles at healthcare data companies, pharma/biotech data vendors, health IT firms, or equivalent
- Demonstrated end-to-end ownership of data integrations built from scratch — scoping, field mapping, QA, and handoff — with documentation to show for it
- Healthcare or life sciences domain context required; ability to ramp on new datasets and source types each quarter without needing deep subject matter expertise upfront
- Analytical fluency to assess data quality; hands-on experience with tools such as VBA, R, or SPSS; SQL a plus but not a primary requirement
- Familiarity with data lake architectures (bronze/silver/gold or equivalent) and how raw data moves through normalization and entity resolution to a product-ready state
- Experience gathering requirements from client-facing stakeholders and translating them into data or product specifications
- Experience at a B2B data company where you understood how external clients consumed your data and where client retention drove decisions
- AWS infrastructure familiarity (Athena, S3, Glue) at a query and inspection level preferred
- Comfort working in Jira or Monday in a ticket-based workflow
- Exceptional written communication — your documentation is legible, maintained, and actually used
 
 
COMPENSATION
This role pays $145,000 to $170,000 per year, based on experience, in addition to equity.
 
Anticipated role close date: 08/25/2026
 
 
 
H1 OFFERS
- Full suite of health insurance options, in addition to generous paid time off
- Pre-planned company-wide wellness holidays
- Retirement options
- Health & charitable donation stipends
- Impactful Business Resource Groups
- Flexible work hours & the opportunity to work from anywhere
- The opportunity to work with leading biotech and life sciences companies in an innovative industry with a mission to improve healthcare around the globe
 
 
H1 is proud to be an equal opportunity employer that celebrates diversity and is committed to creating an inclusive workplace with equal opportunity for all applicants and teammates. Our goal is to recruit the most talented people from a diverse candidate pool regardless of race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion, disability, sex (including pregnancy), age, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, marital status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Talos: Institutional Fabric for the Digital Asset Market

Founded in 2018, Talos provides institutional-grade trading technology for the global digital asset market, powering many of the major players in the crypto ecosystem. Our mission is clear: to advance the mass adoption of digital assets by seamlessly connecting institutions to the digital asset ecosystem. We are committed to building the most innovative and trusted platform in the world, supporting the entire trading lifecycle.

At Talos, you’ll find an environment that champions kindness and respect, values diverse perspectives, and upholds inclusivity at every turn. We believe every member of our team brings invaluable insights and abilities that drive Talos forward. In our pursuit of excellence, we foster a culture of trust, integrity, collaboration, and mutual growth.

We are a tight-knit yet globally distributed team of highly experienced engineers and business leaders, with hubs in New York, London, Singapore, and Cyprus. Whether in-office or remote, you’ll be part of a hybrid-friendly environment where your unique talents and insights will play a crucial role in building something extraordinary.

 

GM, Head of Data

We are seeking someone to lead the Talos data business and position it for strong, sustainable growth. You’ll own the P&L, product strategy and client relationships for our digital assets data offering, built on the Coin Metrics acquisition. Working closely with engineering, sales and executive leadership, you’ll shape how our data products are built, packaged and taken to market. This is a high-ownership role for an experienced business leader who has built or run a data business before and believes digital assets are where markets are heading.

  • Build a commercial model that serves both self-service customers and enterprise clients, including packaging, pricing and distribution.

  • Lead the research, product and data science teams, making sure research drives product development and supports Talos more broadly.

  • Partner with sales, marketing and engineering, which sit outside your reporting line, to align priorities and deliver revenue growth.

  • Own client outcomes and account health, resolving issues and driving retention and expansion.

  • Define the positioning and brand strategy for the data business within the wider Talos group.

  • Build a high-performing, motivated team with a strong sense of ownership and shared identity.

 

Qualifications

  • Executive presence and the ability to engage and constructively challenge senior leadership.

jobs.title: Senior Customer Success Engineer
jobs.description:
Senior Customer Success Engineer

Why join us?

Mitti by SafetyCulture is a global tech company, just not the kind you're picturing. Our almost 1,000-person team builds tools that make work better for the three billion frontline workers who keep the world moving. We've got big tech scale, without the sign-off layers or corporate theatre. This next chapter is about scaling smart, powered by AI, a clear vision and real ownership.

Big tech impact, without the big tech ick.

Role Purpose

This role exists to unlock technical value for Mitti’s customers, designing and implementing solutions that ensure customers integrate deeply with the platform and realise measurable operational outcomes, while bridging the gap between Go-to-Market (GTM) teams and Product, Design & Engineering (PDE). They own end-to-end delivery of integration offerings within defined scope, timeline, and budget, escalating only where customer requirements exceed standard package boundaries.

Key Responsibilities

Drive customer success and stickiness

  • Own technical solution design for select customers: from scoping integrations and data workflows through to working implementations that enable full platform value.

  • Deliver the standard Integration/Automation packages end-to-end: scope confirmation, project delivery, build, testing, and handoff within the defined timeline and effort budget.

  • Advise customers and partners on integration architecture: how to connect Mitti to their existing systems effectively and sustainably.

  • Partner with Customer Success Managers (CSMs) to build implementation plans that accelerate time-to-value for managed accounts.

  • Work alongside Account Executives (AEs) during pre-sales to communicate technical platform capabilities (APIs, security architecture, and cloud integrations) and resolve technical blockers in the sales cycle.

  • Act as a technical bridge between GTM and PDE, capturing and routing customer integration feedback that shapes the product roadmap.

  • Partner with the API and Integrations Engineering team to resolve complex customer requirements and advocate for platform improvements that benefit the broader customer base.

Improve how we deliver

  • Identify recurring technical patterns across customer integrations, propose and participate in standardisation efforts: new packaged offerings, reusable automation, or templated solutions that reduce delivery effort across the customer base, not just for one account.

  • Build and maintain technical automations (scripts, workflows, tooling) that reduce manual effort in the standard delivery motion, contributing them back to the shared Customer Solution & Implementation toolkit rather than keeping them account-specific.

  • Flag when the same "out of scope" request appears repeatedly across customers, as a signal the package boundary itself needs to move, not just that this customer needs an exception.

Required Skills & Experience

Technical Skills

  • Proven ability to design and implement data solutions: writing SQL queries, modelling relational databases, and translating raw data into business-relevant insights.

  • Comfortable building across scripting or programming languages (e.g. Python, JavaScript, Ruby, Golang) to automate workflows or extend platform capabilities for specific customer use cases.

  • Able to navigate a wide variety of enterprise system architectures, data models, and integration patterns.

  • Confident reading API documentation and building or troubleshooting API integrations in enterprise environments.

  • Background spanning software development and data analytics; comfortable moving between building solutions and communicating data-driven insights to non-technical stakeholders.

Behavioural Skills

  • Translates fluently between technical and non-technical audiences: equally credible in an engineering deep-dive and a customer-facing session with business stakeholders.

  • Stays organised across a high-volume, concurrent workload; switches context quickly without losing quality or missing detail.

  • Customer-first problem solver: listens to understand the real need before proposing a solution, and brings options rather than just problems.

  • Self-directed and comfortable with ambiguity; exercises sound judgment on edge cases while operating within a defined delivery methodology.

  • Team-first mindset: invests in the success of CSMs, AEs, and engineering partners, not just their own outcomes.

  • Distinguishes clearly between solving a customer's immediate problem and identifying a systemic delivery improvement worth productising, and routes each appropriately.

AI Skills

  • Uses AI tools to accelerate integration work, drafting technical specs and documentation, analysing customer data to surface insights, and building automations faster.

  • Applies AI coding assistants fluently in day-to-day work; evaluates AI-generated code for quality, correctness, and security before deploying.

  • Proficient with AI tools: independently identifies where AI adds leverage in their workflows and adopts new capabilities without direction.

Benefits

At Mitti, we care about people and growing the team, through:

  • Equity with high growth potential, and a competitive salary,

  • Hybrid working arrangements with flexibility,

  • Access to professional and personal training and development opportunities; Hackathons, Workshops, Lunch & Learns;

  • We encourage involvement in the community, open source work, attending talks and events, and experimenting with new technologies.

You'll also receive other perks such as:

  • Remote flexible working arrangements

jobs.title: Freelance Senior Technical Advisor
jobs.description:
Freelance Senior Technical Advisor

Role Details

Level: Senior/ Lead

Start Date: ASAP

Duration: 6 months

Day Rate: Dependent on experience

Weekly hours: 3-4 days/ week

Location: Remote Europe, GMT/BST or CET friendly

Language: English, plus Spanish and/or Portuguese

 

In this role, you’ll be a senior technical advisor to city governments across North, Central and South America, working in both an advisory and a hands-on capacity to help them design, build and launch small scale pilots of new services for residents.

Working alongside experienced product managers, data scientists, AI engineers, and designers, you’ll help multidisciplinary city teams build in-house product development capability by prototyping and delivering digital products and services, many of which harness data and AI.

You won’t own the decisions, but you’ll shape them. You’ll guide cities through the full product development lifecycle, helping them weigh the strategic and technical trade-offs at each stage: how to design system and data architecture that’s right-sized for a pilot but built to scale, how to prototype and test possible solutions to validate assumptions, and when AI approaches such as machine learning or large language models are the right tool (and when they aren’t). You’ll roll up your sleeves to prototype and demonstrate what good looks like, while making sure your clients understand the reasoning well enough to own the outcome.

This role suits someone with the technical depth of a tech lead, and the judgement, communication skills and patience to lead through influence rather than authority. You’ll need to work fluently in English and in at least one of Spanish or Portuguese.

 

Key skills and experiences

  • Extensive hands-on technical experience, with strong knowledge of system and data architecture, data pipelines, DevOps and infrastructure, and a track record of delivering and deploying robust solutions end to end, from prototype to pilot, across cloud, on-premises and hybrid environments, including legacy systems and resource-constrained ones, so that your recommendations are realistic and buildable.

  • Familiarity with AI and machine learning approaches, including large language models, and experience deploying them or working alongside ML engineers to integrate them into products, with enough understanding to judge when they’re the right tool and how to build them in responsibly.

  • Experience taking products from early concept to first release, while laying foundations for scale, with a track record of rapid prototyping and assumption testing and a “show, don’t tell” approach that uses working prototypes to build shared understanding and inform decisions.

  • Experience working in multidisciplinary teams, collaborating closely with product managers, designers and other disciplines throughout the product lifecycle.

  • The ability to explain technical ideas and trade-offs clearly to audiences of all technical levels, from engineers to non-technical stakeholders and senior decision-makers.

  • Experience setting technical direction for a project or small team and guiding other engineers, as a tech lead or senior engineer.

  • Experience influencing technical decisions you don't directly control, whether in a consulting or advisory role or as an in-house engineer working across teams and with senior stakeholders.

  • Curiosity and flexibility in problem solving, and comfort working through ambiguity and uncertainty in complex environments.

  • Professional working proficiency in English and in Spanish and/or Portuguese.

Nice to have

  • Experience working with multicultural teams and on international projects.

  • Experience working with government or other public-sector organisations, or on services for residents and citizens.

  • Familiarity with responsible AI practices, such as data privacy, bias and fairness, transparency, and the governance considerations specific to public-sector use of AI.

  • Experience supporting organisations to build their own technical capability, for example through coaching, mentoring or setting up new teams and practices.

Our hiring process

We’ve kept the process short and focused. Here’s what to expect:

1. Application & Video
As part of your application, we’ll ask you to record a short video (1–3 minutes, instructions below) describing a technical project — work or personal — that you really enjoyed working on.

  • Please record it in Spanish or Portuguese, whichever you speak fluently.

  • You don’t need to show your face — a voiceover on a screen share, or any other format you’re comfortable with, is fine.

  • We want to understand what the project was and why you enjoyed working on it. This isn’t a test of production quality; we’re interested in how you think and talk about your work.

2. Initial screening call
A short conversation to cover the basics — your timezone, working languages, availability, and a chance for you to ask early questions about the role and how we work.

3. Technical interview (~60 minutes)
A deeper conversation about your technical background and experience. We’ll talk through how you’ve approached real problems, the decisions you’ve made, and how you’d apply that thinking to the work at IF.

4. Ways of working interview (~45–60 minutes)
A conversation about how you collaborate, communicate, and work with others — including how you operate in an advisory capacity with clients and teams.

We’ll aim to keep you updated at every stage and let you know the outcome promptly after each step.


How to record and submit your video

The simplest way is Loom (free, no download needed):

  1. Go to loom.com and create a free account.

  2. Click New video → Record a video in your browser. Choose Screen and camera or Screen only if you’d prefer not to appear on camera, and make sure your microphone is selected.

  3. Record your video — remember, 1 to 3 minutes is all we need. The free plan has a 5-minute limit, which is plenty.

  4. When you stop recording, Loom will open the video and give you a link. Click Copy link.

  5. Check the sharing setting is Anyone with the link can view.

  6. Paste the link into the Link to your video field on the application form.
