jobs.title: Software Engineer, Knowledge Engine – Query Engine
jobs.description:
Software Engineer, Knowledge Engine – Query Engine

Exa is an applied AI lab building a search engine unlike the world has ever seen. We build massive-scale infra to crawl the entire web, train state-of-the-art embedding models to process it, and design super high performant vector databases to retrieve over it. We now power search for Cursor, Cognition, HubSpot, and over 400,000 developers and have raised $350m from Lightspeed, Benchmark, and a16z.

Our ultimate goal is to build perfect search over all the world's information, far beyond Google. If you want to build massive-scale ML systems that will define the way the new AI world consumes information, this is the place for you.

The Knowledge Platform team builds Exa's knowledge engine. We continuously synthesize information from across the web and beyond into one of the world's largest open-domain knowledge graphs, with hundreds of billions of evidence-backed claims. The work has two halves: construction pipelines that decide what to trust, and retrieval engines that decide how best to search it. Our goal is to give agents answers to any factual question about the world with unprecedented precision and completeness.

In this role, you'll own the query engine that searches hundreds of billions of claims across a variety of retrieval backends, from a distributed graph database to vector, full-text, time-series and geospatial indexes.

This is greenfield work with a massive scope. No off-the-shelf system answers precise questions over hundreds of billions of evidence-backed claims at agent speed, so you'll make foundational decisions, from storage layout and indexing across engines to the query language and the planner that routes work between them, that every query depends on.

What you'll do

  • Own storage and indexing across backends: data layout, partitioning and indexes for graph, vector, full-text, time-series and geospatial retrieval, with bulk snapshot builds and live ingest that never take the system down.

  • Decide how best to search: cost-based planning from cardinality estimates that chooses, for each question, which backends to use, in what order and how to join their results, executed as traversals, retrievals, filters and aggregations in one plan.

  • Make it fast at scale: serve thousands of queries per second, profiling and cutting p50/p99 latency, memory and cost per query under high concurrent load, from on-disk layout to network fan-out.

  • Keep answers consistent while the data converges: the graph is fed by live updates and bulk snapshots at once and is eventually consistent by design, so you'll own what a query may see while it converges: consistent snapshot promotion, ordered application of live updates and stable pagination across versions.

  • Measure precision and completeness: end-to-end checks every deployment must pass, plus evals and metrics that show when a plan returns wrong results or misses ones it should have found.

What we're looking for

  • You've worked deep inside a distributed database, query engine, search engine or storage system.

  • Strong grasp of indexing, query planning and optimization, and storage formats.

  • Solid grasp of distributed systems fundamentals: consensus, replication, sharding and fault tolerance.

  • Strong in a systems language (Go, Rust or C++).

  • You profile before you optimize, and you've shipped measured latency wins in production.

  • You obsess over correctness, reliability and data quality as much as scale.

Bonus

  • Graph databases, or combining vector, full-text, time-series and geospatial retrieval

  • Compilers, query language design or cost-based optimizers

Example projects

  • Build a system that retrieves and reasons over everything known about any company or person in the world, answering any factual question precisely and completely.

  • Answer precise multi-hop questions over hundreds of billions of claims at thousands of QPS with interactive latency.

  • Build a planner that picks the right mix of graph, vector, full-text and geospatial retrieval for any question, and proves it chose well.

  • Make new knowledge queryable seconds after it's synthesized, without ever serving an inconsistent result.

Logistics

  • Location: This is an in-person opportunity in Zurich.

  • Visas: We're happy to sponsor international candidates (e.g., STEM OPT, OPT, H1B, O1, E3). While we cannot guarantee your visa, we have historically been successful in sponsoring candidates from all over the world. If you receive an offer, our team will work hard to get you a visa.

  • Benefits: We offer premium healthcare benefits (medical, dental, vision), fertility benefits, 16 weeks of fully paid parental leave for all new parents, and a monthly wellness stipend to all of our employees.

Projectorganisator Bedrijfsbureau

Dit wordt jouw baan

Je vertaalt als Projectorganisator Bedrijfsbureau ontwerpen in optimale en slimme bouwmethodieken. Met jouw technische inzicht, praktische aanpak en overtuigingskracht speel je een sleutelrol in onze tenders en in de voorbereiding van onze projecten. Je werkt op het bedrijfsbureau van Dura Vermeer Bouw en Vastgoed in Rotterdam en maakt onderdeel uit van een ervaren team, met veel vrijheid en ruimte voor initiatief. Jij bent vanaf het begin betrokken bij onze woningbouw- en utiliteitsprojecten. Samen met een team van ervaren collega’s werk je onder andere aan:

·       Het analyseren van constructies en bepalen van de meest optimale bouwmethodiek.

·       Het opstellen van de bouwtijdplanning (Asta Powerproject)

·       Het opstellen van de algemene bouwplaatskosten

·       Het ontwerpen van 3D-bouwplaatsinrichtingen (Revit)

·       Het afstemmen met de materieeldienst, leveranciers en onderaannemers.

·       Input leveren voor BLVC- en logistieke plannen.

·       Input leveren voor een onderbouwd plan van aanpak om tenders te winnen.

Jouw bijdrage is cruciaal voor het binnenhalen en goed voorbereiden van onze projecten. Je denkt actief mee over alternatieven en innovaties, met oog voor duurzaamheid en veranderende regelgeving.

 

Meer bij Dura Vermeer

Dura Vermeer is een onafhankelijk familiebedrijf. En dat merk je. In hoe we samenwerken, naar elkaar omkijken en bouwen met oog voor de volgende generaties. Al sinds 1855 bouwen we aan Nederland, in woningbouw, utiliteitsbouw, infrastructuur en techniek. Onze onafhankelijkheid en lange termijn visie vormen daarbij de basis.

Met een omzet van € 2,6 miljard en ruim 3.700 collega’s behoren we tot de top van de Nederlandse bouwsector. Maar uiteindelijk draait het bij ons niet om die cijfers. Het draait om mensen. Om collega’s die samen werken aan projecten waar je trots op bent – iconisch én dichtbij – en bijdragen aan oplossingen voor maatschappelijke vraagstukken.

Onze ambities zijn groot. En die maken we alleen waar met betrokken mensen. Daarom investeren we in goed werkgeverschap en een werkomgeving waarin jij je thuis voelt. Waar je jezelf kunt zijn, je veilig voelt en je uitspreekt. Zodat jij het beste uit jezelf haalt en samen met ons meer maakt.

Hier zit je op je plek

Dura Vermeer Bouw en Vastgoed Rotterdam is een grote werkmaatschappij binnen de Dura Vermeer Groep en opereert als een ontwikkelende bouwer in de regio Zuid-Holland. We zijn gespecialiseerd in het bouwen van woningen, zowel gestapeld als grondgebonden, en utilitaire gebouwen, met de focus op nieuwbouwprojecten.

Ons team is verdeeld in zes zelfstandige waardestromen, elk met hun eigen expertise. Binnen deze teams, die uit ongeveer 35 collega’s bestaan, werken we met alle benodigde disciplines samen. De structuur is plat en zonder overbodige hiërarchie, wat zorgt voor een prettige, efficiënte samenwerking. Zo combineren we de voordelen van een groot bedrijf met de warme, persoonlijke sfeer van kleinschaliger teams: de waardestromen.

Bij ons heerst een informele sfeer met een typisch Rotterdamse mentaliteit: hard werken, maar ook hard lachen. We helpen elkaar waar nodig en dankzij de veilige en inclusieve werkomgeving waar iedereen zichzelf kan zijn, staan we bekend als een fijne plek om te werken!


Dit breng je mee

·       Je hebt minimaal 3 jaar ervaring in de werkvoorbereiding, uitvoering of als bouwtechnoloog/projectorganisator.

·       Je hebt een afgeronde bouwkundige opleiding.

·       Je hebt ervaring met Asta powerproject en Revit.

·       Je hebt technisch inzicht en werkt gestructureerd.

·       Je kan goed samenwerken, neemt initiatief en denkt een stap vooruit.

·       Jij staat voor jouw oplossingen en kan deze mondeling goed toelichten aan o.a. uitvoering.

·       Je kunt snel schakelen tussen verschillende werkzaamheden en bent stressbestendig

Deze punten geven een beeld van het profiel dat wij zoeken. Herken jij jezelf niet volledig in alle punten, maar denk je wel dat deze functie bij je past? Dan gaan we graag met je in gesprek.

Tebi is creating the first Connected Restaurant Management System that makes hospitality flow. In one seamless platform, Tebi embeds sales, reservations, kitchen prep, payments, and all the data that powers it, creating smooth service and intuitive insights.

Founded by Arnout Schuijff, co-founder of Adyen, and backed by €50 million in funding from Index Ventures & CapitalG, Tebi is built in service of hospitality first. Thousands of restaurants, cafés, bars, and coffee shops across the Netherlands, UK, Italy, Spain, Germany, Denmark and Finland already love running on Tebi.

About the role:

We’re looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to help us build powerful, delightful features that empower restaurant teams. You’ll work across the stack to bring new ideas to life, whether it’s building intuitive interfaces, scalable backend services, or the glue in between that makes everything feel seamless.

You’ll collaborate closely with design, product, and other engineers to rapidly ship impactful features. As an early team member, you’ll also help shape our engineering culture, tooling, and technical direction.

This role is perfect for someone who thrives in fast-paced environments, loves solving real user problems, and wants to help modernize an underserved industry with thoughtful, elegant software.

Responsibilities:

  • Build, test, and ship end-to-end features across the stack—from APIs and data models.

  • Collaborate with designers and PMs to translate user needs into working, intuitive product experiences

  • Own projects from concept to launch and beyond, balancing speed, quality, and scalability

  • Improve system performance and reliability across frontend and backend systems

  • Help evolve our codebase and technical architecture as we scale

  • Contribute to shared tooling, component libraries, and best practices that level up the whole team

What you’ll need:

  • 8+ years of professional experience as a fullstack or backend engineer in a product-focused environment

  • Deep expertise in either Kotlin, Java, or Scala.

  • Significant experience with distributed systems. You know how to build and maintain scalable, resilient services that work together.

Restaurants and other merchants use various software systems such as Point of Sale (POS), Reservations, Kitchen Display Systems (KDS), Payments, Inventory, Staffing, and the list goes on. These systems all need to speak to each other which they frequently don’t. It’s a mess, and we are fixing it.

We use AI the way our merchants use Tebi, to cut out the friction and get to what matters faster. We believe in a world where AI increases quality, efficiency and speed.

At Tebi, AI isn't a policy or a checkbox, it's just part of how we work. It helps us write, analyse, build, and improve but doesn’t make the last call. If there's a smarter way to do something, we want to find it.

We are seeking a Marketing Analytics Director to lead the evolution of our marketing data stack and raise the analytical rigor of the entire marketing organization. This is a critical role for a builder-practitioner who works at the intersection of Data Science, Marketing Strategy, GTM, and AI Operations. You won't just report on the funnel. You will build the systems that make every analyst on this team sharper, including the AI agents themselves.

As the Marketing Analytics Director , you will be the lead architect of our data-driven growth engine, connecting high-level strategy with advanced technical execution. You will move beyond traditional reporting to build a self-sustaining marketing ecosystem, leveraging Google BigQuery, Grafana, and agentic AI to create a unified source of truth and a culture of analytical rigor. Your mandate is to move the needle on demand generation across the entire marketing funnel, while raising the standard for how analytical work gets produced, challenged, and shipped across the org.

You will architect a dual-track target-setting framework that balances high-velocity top-of-funnel growth with deep-funnel quality, ensuring GTM resources are directed toward high-converting user cohorts optimized for Grafana adoption and long-term retention.

You will be expected to engineer the underlying data schemas, design predictive models, and implement the BI frameworks that shape our global GTM strategy. We are looking for a technical expert who can translate complex data into clear executive-level direction and who proactively builds systems that prevent AI-generated noise from drowning out actual signals.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Strategic GTM Partnership: Serve as the primary strategic partner to the GTM Leadership team (VP of Demand Gen, VP of Regional and Events, Head of Marketing Ops, CMO, Revenue Operations, Sales leadership and more), translating complex data into a clear roadmap for demand generation and revenue growth.
  • Dual-Track Target Setting: Architect and own a sophisticated forecasting framework that balances top-of-funnel volume with high-intent lead quality, optimized for Grafana Cloud conversion and retention.
  • Predictive Modeling and ROI: Develop and maintain machine learning models (Attribution, MMM, LTV) to predict campaign impact and steer budget allocation toward the highest-ROI channels.
  • Data Warehouse Architecture: Oversee the structure of marketing data within Google BigQuery, ensuring a scalable single source of truth that connects product usage data with marketing touchpoints.
  • Causal Inference and Inflection Hunting: Move beyond descriptive analytics to perform causal inference and predictive trend analysis. When the data shows an anomaly, whether a 3-month spike, a regional dip, or a campaign that overperformed, isolate the window and dig in.
  • Executive Storytelling: Transform technical data outputs into clear, compelling narratives for the executive team and board. Deliver a succinct read and go deep where pushed.

Utilizing AI and Automation

  • Agentic Insights: Deploy LLM-powered agents (Claude Code, MCP-based tooling, or comparable) to monitor BigQuery datasets and automatically flag quality shifts in the funnel before they impact revenue.
  • Autonomous Workflows: Implement orchestration patterns (N8N, custom MCP servers, or equivalent) to build self-healing data pipelines and automated responses to market signals, such as automated spend shifts based on conversion anomalies.
  • Predictive Quality Scoring: Build and deploy AI-driven scoring models that separate high-value potential users from low-signal volume, helping Sales and Marketing prioritize effectively.

What Makes You a Great Fit

  • 8+ years in Marketing Analytics, GTM Strategy, or Data Science, with at least 2 years in a lead architect capacity (IC track or player-coach; people management not required) within a high-growth SaaS or PLG environment.
  • Demonstrated history as a force multiplier. You can point to specific tooling, rituals, evaluator systems, or frameworks you built that made other analysts or the broader org measurably better. A portfolio of dashboards you personally produced is not sufficient.
  • Data Science and Engineering: Mastery of SQL and Python required. Deep experience architecting data environments in Google BigQuery, Snowflake, or similar warehouses.
  • Hands-on AI fluency as a builder, not a user. You have built and shipped agentic systems with Claude Code, MCP, or comparable tools. You understand where LLMs fail and how to design around those limitations. You have built evaluator agents, prompt-grading systems, or analytical quality tooling in production.
  • Automation Proficiency: Hands-on experience building complex logic and integrations using N8N, custom API orchestration, or MCP-based tooling.
  • Visualization and BI: Advanced proficiency in modern data stack visualization tools (Grafana, Looker, Tableau) to build executive-grade dashboards.
  • Strategic Acumen: Proven ability to create structure in highly ambiguous environments and build target-setting frameworks from scratch.
  • MarTech Ecosystem: Deep familiarity with connectivity between Salesforce, marketing automation, and product-led data streams.
  • Executive presence with experience presenting to executive and board audiences, including sound judgment about what data is and isn't ready to share up the chain.

Bonus Points For

  • Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in a quantitative field (Data Science, CS, Statistics, Business Analytics). MBA or MS in Data Science is a significant plus.

  • Competitive compensation and real share options aligned with responsibility and impact, not tenure or hierarchy.

jobs.title: Security and Compliance Engineer
jobs.description:
Security and Compliance Engineer

About Griffin

Hi, we’re Griffin. We’re a fully regulated UK bank that powers the accounts and payments offerings of product-led fintechs and platforms like Uber, Yonder, Prosper, and Sidekick. By doing the heavy lifting behind the scenes, our customers can focus on what they do best - delivering amazing customer experiences.

We’ve grown rapidly since our launch in 2024, and today provide the banking backbone behind products in remittance, payroll, wealth, insurance, proptech, payments, neobanking and more.

We’re moving into card issuing, stablecoin infrastructure, and agentic finance next as we continue to support the next generation of product-led companies.

Learn more about what we do

Our culture

We believe that smart, motivated, conscientious people thrive in high-trust, high-autonomy environments and have done our best to create such an environment at Griffin. People who thrive here don’t require much hand-holding, and go out of their way to figure out how to contribute in the most valuable way possible.

We've been remote-first since we were established in 2017 and we remain so today. Work here is asynchronous and fully flexible - because we want to be a part of your life in a way that helps you to get the most out of both your work and home life.

We understand that our culture and ways of working aren’t for everyone, and we’re very intentional about our hiring process as a result. We won't hire people who don’t seem like a strong fit for our core values, even if they're otherwise extremely qualified.

Our strong culture has helped us to remain a mission-driven company as we have scaled, and gives our people a clear, explicit operating framework and the space to focus on delivering real value for our customers.

Learn more about our culture.

The Team

The Craft function has seven small, cross-functional engineering teams - each with engineers, an engineering manager, and a product manager, working closely with designers.

You will work across the whole Craft function, with the remit of improving our controls and cyber security governance. You will initially work with and report to the Engineering Manager for Infrastructure as you establish yourself and take on your day to day responsibilities, additionally you will work closely with our CTO and Founder, Allen Rohner.

The Opportunity

We're looking for an Engineer 1.5 to become the engineering voice of security, compliance and assurance at Griffin. Sitting across engineering, security, risk and operational resilience, you'll turn standards and regulatory expectations into practical controls that engineers actually want to use and you’ll build those controls yourself, shipping code to production alongside the engineering team. You’ll also give our second and third lines real confidence in what we’ve built. It’s a rare hybrid role with broad ownership and a direct hand in strengthening Griffin’s security.

What Success Looks Like

In your first 6 months, you'll have taken ownership of our certification, attestation and audit work including ISO 27001 and SWIFT, with evidence organised and findings driven through to closure. Our engineering risks and controls will be well maintained, and our release, change and post-incident processes will be stronger. You’ll have shipped code that automates control checks and evidence collection, and you’ll be a regular contributor to our codebase.

By month 12 our resilience plans, including Important Business Service technical mapping, B& Continuity Planning and disaster recovery, will be current, and security and compliance will be easier to run and easier to demonstrate to customers, thanks to clearer ownership and smart automation.

To Do This You’ll Own

  • Control design and cyber security governance: translating standards into practical engineering controls and building and shipping the code that puts them in place, working with Engineering teams to get them live

  • Certifications and attestations, from SWIFT and FPS today to schemes like SOC 2 and ISO 27001 in the future, including the documentation behind them

  • Internal and external audits and customer due diligence requests, owning findings and driving them to closure

  • Engineering Risk and Controls Self Assessments, controls and actions, plus recurring control activity such as chaos testing and backup/restore

  • Code release and change management, improving the process and sampling releases to check adherence to policy

  • Post-incident reviews, including follow-up actions and sharing learnings with the right stakeholders

  • Engineering's contribution to operational resilience (DR plans and IBS technical mapping) and to managing engineering third parties alongside Operations

We expect you to shape this role

This description reflects what we need today. How you achieve these outcomes, where you focus your energy, how this role evolves—that's for you to define as you learn what our customers need and where our technical gaps are.

Your background

To ensure this, we're looking for people who have:

jobs.title: Data Scientist Internship
jobs.description:
Data Scientist Internship
Your mission

Our Engineering team

Our Engineering team is responsible for developing our SaaS platform and building a comprehensive and user-friendly product. Pigment engineers participate in the entire application development lifecycle, focusing on design, coding, and keeping the production platform up and running. They can be specialized, but there is no strict separation between infrastructure, backend, and frontend.

We value user-centricity and pragmatism: we choose the most relevant tools for the problem we have to solve, understanding the strengths and constraints of each technology. Our engineering culture also values curiosity, humility, trust, ownership, and team spirit.

👉 Curious to see what we’re building? Check out our Tech Blog!

As a Data Scientist Intern, you will help us push the boundaries of what AI can do inside Pigment, focusing on how our AI Modeler builds and maintains planning models. You’ll work closely with our AI engineering and data science teams to design, test, and evaluate LLM-based systems that turn loosely structured inputs into reliable, working Pigment models and formulas.

Project Overview: Making Pigment’s AI Modeler Smarter

Depending on your profile and interests, you will focus on one of these topics:

1. Formula Writing from Specifications

Have the Modeler write a specification of a formula (what it should do, and the tests it must pass), then build a small Formula Writer model that produces a correct formula from it.

2. Building Models from External Documents

Turn amorphous inputs (long PDFs, call transcripts, existing applications, templates) into structured Pigment applications: write the tests first, then iterate on a DSL representation until they pass.

3. Building Models from Databases

Given an existing database, determine which blocks and transformations to create to make sense of the data and integrate it as a Pigment model.

As an intern, you will:

  • Define success criteria, test suites, and evaluation metrics for your topic.
  • Design and iterate on LLM-based approaches (prompting, agentic workflows, intermediate representations).
  • Benchmark quality, reliability, and cost/latency, and document trade-offs.
  • Work with engineers and data scientists to build evaluation pipelines and share findings.

    • Technical Stack

    Our current AI and engineering stack includes:

  • Languages & Frameworks: Python, LangGraph
  • Data & ML Infrastructure: Weights & Biases, Hugging Face Hub, Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Docker, Kubernetes
  • Databases: PostgreSQL

Machine Learning Engineer – Practice IA MARGO
Qui sommes nous ?
 
Chez MARGO, nos consultants travaillent sur ce qui compte vraiment : des projets complexes qui allient challenge intellectuel et impact business réel.
C’est pourquoi nous accompagnons les plus grands acteurs de la finance, de l’industrie et de la tech sur leurs projets les plus stratégiques en Data Science, Machine Learning et Intelligence Artificielle.
 
Pourquoi rejoindre la practice IA ?
 
Vous évoluerez au sein d’une équipe encadrée par Hamza Bouanani, Practice Manager IA chez MARGO, également Lead Data Scientist chez BNP Paribas.
 
Travailler à ses côtés, c’est intégrer une équipe d’experts passionnés, être challengé sur le plan technique et méthodologique, et contribuer à des projets à fort impact pour les clients.
 
Vos missions
 
Nous recherchons un Machine Learning Engineer pour rejoindre nos équipes et intervenir au cœur de la stratégie Data de nos clients (Industrie, Finance, Énergie). Votre objectif principal sera d'industrialiser les algorithmes de Machine Learning et de garantir leur cycle de vie en production.
 
Vous interviendrez sur trois axes techniques majeurs :
 
1. Industrialisation & Déploiement (Model Serving)
- Transformation des modèles de recherche (Proof of Concept) en code de production robuste, testé et optimisé.
- Développement d'APIs performantes (FastAPI, Flask) pour exposer les modèles aux applications métiers.
- Conteneurisation des solutions (Docker) et orchestration sur des clusters (Kubernetes) pour assurer la scalabilité et la haute disponibilité.
 
2. Architecture MLOps & Automatisation
- Conception et maintenance de pipelines CI/CD dédiés au Machine Learning (réentraînement automatique, validation des modèles).
- Mise en place et gestion d'outils d'orchestration de flux de données (Airflow, Kubeflow, Dagster).
- Gestion du versioning des données et des modèles (DVC, MLflow) pour assurer la reproductibilité des expériences.
 
3. Performance & Optimisation
- Optimisation des temps de réponse (latence) et de l'utilisation des ressources de calcul (CPU/GPU).
- Refactoring de code pour respecter les standards de Software Craftsmanship (Clean Code, TDD).
- Gestion des Feature Stores pour centraliser et servir les variables calculées en temps réel.
 
Votre rôle inclura également :
Monitoring avancé : Mise en place de sondes pour détecter le "Data Drift" (dérive des données) ou le "Model Drift" et déclencher des alertes proactives.
Collaboration transverse : Faire le pont entre les Data Scientists (mathématiques/modélisation) et les Data Engineers (infrastructure/données) pour fluidifier les mises en production.
Évangélisation : Diffuser les bonnes pratiques de développement logiciel au sein des équipes Data Science.
 
Profil recherché
 
Nous cherchons un profil hybride, à la frontière entre le Software Engineering et la Data Science, capable de comprendre les mathématiques sous-jacentes tout en maîtrisant les contraintes de production informatique.
 
- Formation : Bac+5 (école d’ingénieur, université) en Informatique ou Mathématiques Appliquées.
- Compétences Techniques Cœurs :
* Maîtrise avancée de Python et des bonnes pratiques logicielles (Git, Tests unitaires/d'intégration, Packaging).
* Solide expérience sur les plateformes Cloud (AWS, Azure ou GCP) et l'IaC (Terraform est un plus).
* Maîtrise de l'écosystème MLOps : MLflow, Kubeflow, Docker, Kubernetes.
- Connaissances Data : Bonne compréhension des bibliothèques ML (Scikit-learn, Pandas) et Deep Learning (TensorFlow, PyTorch) pour pouvoir optimiser le code des Data Scientists.
- Expérience : Vous avez une expérience significative dans le déploiement de modèles ML en production (batch ou temps réel).
- Mindset :
* Rigueur absolue sur la qualité du code et l'automatisation.
* Goût pour la résolution de problèmes d'architecture complexes.
* Capacité à travailler dans des environnements techniques hétérogènes.
 
Ce que nous offrons
 
- Des missions ambitieuses et variées, toujours sélectionnées pour leur valeur ajoutée ;
- Un accompagnement de proximité par des experts reconnus ;
- Une communauté d’ingénieurs passionnés, avec workshops, conférences et échanges réguliers ;
- Une culture d’exigence technique, de partage des connaissances et de développement continu.
 
La suite ?
 
Premier entretien : Échangez avec un recruteur et un business developer
Entretien Technique : Montrez vos compétences et recevez un retour d'expérience
Entretien de Motivation : Rencontrez un membre du comité de direction

MARGO s'engage à offrir des opportunités égales à tous, nous cultivons un environnement de travail inclusif qui valorise la diversité.

jobs.title: Senior Backend Developer
jobs.description:
Senior Backend Developer

Payroll that runs itself. You build the part that runs it.

quinn is an app-based managed payroll and employment-administration service for households and companies who employ people directly. The customer stays the legal employer. quinn registers the employment, runs payroll, pays salaries, social insurance and taxes, and handles every filing that follows, on their behalf and automated end to end.

We don’t sell payroll software. We run payroll.

We operate in Switzerland, Germany and the UK. Last year more than CHF 200 million in salaries ran through our systems, correct to the cent. The purpose behind it is simple: fair employment, for all.

Why this role exists

Every market brings its own authorities, insurers, pension funds and tax rules. Our answer is quinn ONE: one platform for every product and market, with a shared core for what all countries have in common and a configuration layer per country on top, designed to carry twelve countries.

The backend is that core. It is a modular monolith in C#, .NET 10 and PostgreSQL, serving one quinn app for employers, employees and our own support team, Maestro for batch processing, and our AI agents. Development has started, and the foundations the platform will run on for years are being laid now.

This role is fully focused on quinn ONE. Our existing products are not part of it.

What you will own

  • Backend modules, end to end. Design, build, test and run modules and the APIs they expose, from requirements to production, without waiting to be handed a ticket.

  • The data. The PostgreSQL model the platform rests on: schema design, migrations, transactions, indexing, and the calculations that must be right to the cent.

  • The foundations. Audit trail, logging, versioning of our APIs and services, and the database upgrades that keep the platform current.

  • Reliability and security in production. Tests, observability, performance, and data protection by design: an API returns what is needed, not everything that is available. Root causes, not symptoms.

  • The architecture, pragmatically. Module boundaries, dependencies, the shared core and the country layers, evolved with clear trade-offs rather than fashionable patterns.

  • The engineering bar. Code review, design discussions, and mentoring the developers around you, in Zurich and in our Armenia team.

Where the frontend ends, the backend begins. Our Product Frontend Engineer owns everything on the screen: the app, Maestro’s interface, the component library. You own everything behind it: the domain model, the payroll logic, the APIs, the integrations with authorities, insurers and banks, and the data. You agree the API contract together, and Product decides what gets built.

How we work

We are AI-native, operationally rather than as a slogan. AI is how a small team ships like a large one, and how one engineer can hold the standard described here.

We expect you to live in these tools and build your own leverage with them: scaffolding, test generation, migration checks, and whatever else takes manual work out of the way.

And we expect the judgement that comes with it. AI writes code that looks right and is subtly wrong: a transaction boundary in the wrong place, a migration that works on test data and locks a table in production. In payroll, an amount is either right or wrong. You take the speed and keep the standard.

Your first year

In your first month, you set up, learn the system and the people, and merge your first changes. Within 100 days, you have delivered the platform’s audit trail, tested and documented, and fixed the first risks you spotted on arrival.

By month nine, you are the person the team turns to for the quinn backend, and a developer you mentored is delivering features on their own. By the end of the year, the major backend roadmap items are live (logging, the database upgrade, versioning for our APIs and services), and at least one standard you introduced is used beyond your own team.

Who we are looking for

  • You have shipped and run production systems in C# and modern .NET / ASP.NET Core, and you know how they behave under load.

  • You know PostgreSQL properly: schema design, transactions, locking, indexing and query optimisation. You read the execution plan before you add a cache.

  • You have designed APIs and modules with clear boundaries and manageable dependencies.

  • You treat personal and financial data with care. Security is part of how you design, not a review at the end.

  • You use AI tools every day, and you can show where they made you faster and where you caught them being wrong.

  • You own initiatives independently and raise risks before they become surprises.

  • You review constructively, mentor willingly, and write code others can take over.

  • English is your working language. German is a plus.

What makes you stand out

  • You have worked where an amount is either right or wrong: payroll, banking, insurance, accounting or tax.

  • You have built foundations others relied on for years: an audit trail, observability, API versioning, a data model.

  • You have taken a major database upgrade or migration through production without drama.

  • You can explain what you built, why you chose your approach, and what changed because of it.

The team

We are a small, fast and direct team: engineers in Zurich working closely with our Armenia team, and colleagues across Switzerland, Germany and the UK, 40 people in all. Not much process, not much hierarchy. A clear strategy, an ambitious plan, and five values we mean: be open, own it, speak up, keep it simple, bias for action.

jobs.title: Manager CTO Office
jobs.description:
Manager CTO Office

Wat je over ons moet weten?

Wij zijn Athora Netherlands, een verzekeringsbedrijf met de bekende merken Zwitserleven en Reaal. Wij houden ons voornamelijk bezig met pensioenen en levensverzekeringen op de Nederlandse markt. Dat doen wij als onderdeel van een Europese groep met vestigingen in Ierland, het Verenigd Koninkrijk, België, Duitsland en Italië. Wij zijn een sterk bedrijf met ruim één miljoen klanten en we willen de komende jaren doorgroeien tot een van de belangrijkste spelers in de snel veranderende pensioenmarkt. Daarom zoeken wij mensen die niet terugdeinzen voor verandering, die van aanpakken weten, die de ambitie hebben om resultaten neer te zetten en die daarom het beste uit zichzelf en hun team weten te halen. Slimmer samen, noemen wij dat.

Wat ga je doen?

Als Manager CTO Office rapporteer je rechtstreeks aan de CTO en geef je leiding aan circa 16 IT-professionals. Het CTO Office is het centrale regie- en ondersteuningsorgaan binnen het CTO-domein.

Vanuit het team zorg je ervoor dat het Technology - domein aantoonbaar in control is, met geïntegreerde sturing op onder andere governance, risk, performance, change portfolio en Third Parties.

Samen met je team zorg je voor betrouwbare, veilige en klant- en businessgerichte Technology-dienstverlening. Je bouwt aan een professionele, resultaatgerichte werkomgeving waarin continu leren, talentontwikkeling, vakmanschap, eigenaarschap en continu verbeteren centraal staan.

Als Manager CTO Office heb je een sleutelrol binnen het MT Technology en rapporteer je rechtstreeks aan de CTO. Je verbindt leiderschap en strategisch inzicht met een pragmatische aanpak. Zo zorg je voor samenhangende sturing en beheersing van het Technology-domein, waarbij governance en control bijdragen aan betere besluitvorming en een effectieve IT-organisatie.

Sturing en beheersing
Je ontwikkelt en implementeert een integrale visie op governance en control, waarmee Athora effectief voldoet aan interne en externe verplichtingen en tegelijkertijd ruimte creëert voor innovatie en groei. Je geeft richting aan governance, quality & risk management, procesmanagement, compliance, performance management, service management en demand & delivery management. Daarbij stuur je actief op kwaliteit, voorspelbaarheid en continue verbetering, zodat managementbeslissingen gebaseerd zijn op heldere inzichten en meetbare resultaten.

Verandering en verbetering
Je ontwikkelt en bestuurt het change portfolio voor het CTO-domein. Daarbij zoek je continu naar manieren om de organisatie slimmer, eenvoudiger en effectiever te laten werken en zorgt dat veranderingen bijdragen aan de strategische doelen van Athora.

Jouw belangrijkste verantwoordelijkheden:

  • Je leidt het CTO Office, ontwikkelt talent en versterkt vakmanschap, eigenaarschap en een professionele, resultaatgerichte cultuur;

  • Je stuurt het Technology changeportfolio aan en zoekt daarbij actief de verbinding met de betrokken Change & Agility managers en de centrale portfoliofunctie;

  • Je ontwikkelt en verbetert de IT-governance: je verduidelijkt verantwoordelijkheden, versterkt de besluitvorming en geeft richting en waarborgt aansluiting tussen Technology Governance en Data & AI Governance belegd bij het Data & AI Office;

  • Je borgt samen met de relevante stakeholders kwaliteit, risicobeheersing en compliance binnen Technology;

  • Je bereidt namens Technology de overleggen voor met toezichthouders zoals DNB, de externe accountant, Internal Audit en tweedelijns controlefuncties;

  • Je voert de regie over Third Party Risk Management en waarborgt dat risico's, prestaties en compliance van strategische IT-sourcingpartners effectief worden beheerst;

  • Je ontwikkelt en bewaakt de sourcingstrategie en het outsourcingbeleid. Ook organiseer en bewaak je de governance en monitoring van kritieke uitbestede activiteiten;

  • Je levert heldere operationele, tactische en strategische stuurinformatie en versterkt daarmee transparante besluitvorming en een sterke performancecultuur.

  • Je bewaakt budgetten, beheerst kosten en maakt de financiën binnen Technology en de onderliggende dienstverlening inzichtelijk;

  • Je coacht en geeft functioneel leiding aan Product Owners, Release Train Engineers en Scrum Masters binnen Technology.


Wat vragen we van jou?

Voor deze rol zoeken we een ervaren manager die overzicht weet te houden in een complex Technology-landschap en tegelijkertijd dicht genoeg op de uitvoering zit om daadwerkelijk verandering te realiseren.

Dit breng je minimaal mee:

  • WO-werk- en -denkniveau en een relevante opleiding, bij voorkeur in informatiemanagement, IT, bedrijfskunde of een vergelijkbare richting;

  • Minimaal 10 jaar relevante ervaring binnen de financiële dienstverlening, met een sterk trackrecord op het gebied van strategisch advies, Governance, IT-governance, IT-procesmanagement, quality & risk control en performance-, service- en demand & delivery management;

  • Ruime ervaring met het aansturen, ontwikkelen en inspireren van teams van vergelijkbare omvang, waarbij je medewerkers in staat stelt het beste uit zichzelf te halen;

  • Diepgaande kennis van IT4IT, COBIT en andere toonaangevende IT-standaarden en frameworks, en het vermogen deze effectief toe te passen in een complexe organisatieomgeving;

  • Aantoonbare ervaring met SAFe-principes en Agile werken, inclusief incrementplanning, sprintcadans, backlogmanagement en het succesvol managen van afhankelijkheden tussen teams;

  • Sterke verandermanagementvaardigheden, waarbij je strategische ambities vertaalt naar concrete initiatieven en blijvende resultaten realiseert;

  • Uitstekende stakeholdermanagementvaardigheden en het vermogen om effectief samen te werken met senior management, Legal & Compliance, Risk, Internal Audit en externe accountants;

  • Uitstekende communicatieve vaardigheden in zowel Nederlands als Engels, mondeling en schriftelijk.

Wat krijg je van ons?

Je krijgt pakweg 900 collega’s die allemaal vinden dat ze bij een bijzonder bedrijf werken. Je krijgt de mogelijkheid om een belangrijke bijdrage te leveren aan het maatschappelijk relevante thema van pensioenen. Wij zorgen ervoor dat je pensioen goed geregeld is, zodat je zorgeloos kan genieten van je oude dag.


Jij krijgt de kans om echt het verschil te maken als het gaat om duurzaamheid, omdat we in onze bedrijfsvoering en onze beleggingen al jaren de toon aangeven. Uiteraard krijg je een (flexibele) werkplek op ons kantoor in Amsterdam dat behoort tot de beste 7% van de wereld, echt waar. En omdat je ook regelmatig thuis zult werken, ontvang je een budget om je thuiswerkplek goed in te richten.


In ruil voor jouw inzet, talent en vaardigheden krijg je naast je salaris plus een vakantietoeslag en een dertiende maand, 27 vakantiedagen (bij een contract van 36 uur) en een OV-kaart of reiskostenvergoeding voor de dagen dat je naar kantoor komt. En, niet onbelangrijk vinden wij, krijg je een goed opleidingsbudget, zodat je jezelf kunt blijven ontwikkelen. Zo krijg je de kans om door te groeien, binnen ons bedrijf of daarbuiten.


Salaris per maand:
Op basis van cao schaal 19 HAY is de range € 7.872,85 tot € 10.497,13 op basis van 36 uur.

Enthousiast?

Jouw vooruitgang begint bij Berenschot

Wil jij bijdragen aan een financieel gezonde publieke sector? En krijg je energie van complexe financiële vraagstukken binnen de overheid? Dan ben jij misschien de nieuwe senior consultant financiën overheid die we zoeken!

Dit ga je doen

Als senior consultant financiën overheid werk je aan diverse opdrachten binnen de publieke sector, met een focus op financiële vraagstukken bij gemeenten, provincies en het Rijk. Je ondersteunt overheden bij het op orde brengen en houden van hun financiën en zorgt ervoor dat zij grip krijgen op hun begroting. Daarbij ben je breed inzetbaar en krijg je de kans om nieuwe onderwerpen op te pakken. Jouw taken en verantwoordelijkheden zijn onder andere:

  • Adviseren over financiën, begrotingen en bezuinigingsvraagstukken.

  • Uitvoeren van haalbaarheidsstudies en businesscases voor publieke organisaties.

  • Ondersteunen van concerncontrolfuncties binnen gemeenten, provincies en ministeries.

  • Het analyseren van de financiële en beleidsmatige ruimte en adviseren over strategische keuzes.

  • Bijdragen aan de verdere ontwikkeling van digitale tools en AI-toepassingen binnen financiën.

  • Actief bijdragen aan de groei en ontwikkeling van de adviesgroep door jouw commerciële vaardigheden en netwerk.

Quote

‘Overheden staan voor complexe financiële uitdagingen. Samen met mijn collega's help ik hen om grip te krijgen op hun financiën en strategische keuzes te maken die écht impact hebben.’ – Senior managing consultant financiën Openbaar Bestuur

Hier kom je terecht

Berenschot is een zelfstandig en onafhankelijk Nederlands organisatieadviesbureau in Utrecht, waar we met meer dan 500 gedreven collega’s werken aan duurzame oplossingen voor de vraagstukken van onze opdrachtgevers. We dragen bij aan vooruitgang in organisaties en de maatschappij met onze adviezen en oplossingen. Onze organisatie heeft een platte structuur zonder partners, waardoor je invloed hebt op de projecten die je uitvoert. We streven altijd naar verrassende en vernieuwende oplossingen, wat ons uniek maakt. Met een open en informele cultuur, samenwerking tussen verschillende vakgebieden en veel vrijheid en verantwoordelijkheid vanaf dag één, krijg je de kans om te ontdekken wat je belangrijk vindt, waar je kracht ligt en waarin jij je wilt ontwikkelen.

Dit zijn je directe collega’s

Je maakt deel uit van het team Financiën, bedrijfsvoering en control, binnen de adviesgroep Openbaar Bestuur. Samen met je collega's werk je aan de verantwoorde en effectieve besteding van publieke middelen. Je werkt in een hecht en gezellig team van ervaren consultants en experts, waar samenwerken en kennisdeling centraal staan.

De adviesgroep Openbaar Bestuur bestaat uit ongeveer honderd adviseurs met ieder hun eigen specialisatie. Er werken financieel deskundigen, crisis- en veiligheidsexperts, bestuurskundigen, juristen, politicologen, experts binnen de kunst- en cultuursector en communicatiespecialisten. We zijn een jonge, eigenzinnige club die in wisselende samenstellingen aan projecten werkt. Onze adviseurs zijn intelligente mensen met een duidelijke mening vanuit stevige kennis en professionaliteit.

Werken bij Berenschot | Hoe is het om te werken bij ons adviesbureau


Dit neem je mee

Herken jij jezelf in de volgende punten? Dan maken we graag kennis met je.

  • Academisch werk- en denkniveau. Een afgeronde opleiding in bijvoorbeeld (bedrijfs)economie, Certified Public Controller, registeraccountant, bestuurskunde, politicologie of rechten.

  • Werkervaring bij een adviesbureau of bij een gemeente, provincie of het Rijk, bij voorkeur in een financiële rol of controlrol.

  • Flexibiliteit in tijd en inzet en de vaardigheid om zelfstandig te werken.

Dit geeft ons veel ruimte en vrijheid om te ondernemen en de mogelijkheid om ons in te zetten voor belangrijke maatschappelijke thema’s. Kenmerkend is onze informele cultuur. Berenschot is een platte organisatie met korte communicatielijnen waar echt naar je geluisterd wordt. Er zijn volop mogelijkheden voor persoonlijke en professionele groei, waarbij jouw initiatief wordt omarmd en gefaciliteerd. Je hebt hier de vrijheid om te ondernemen. Ons diverse en inclusieve personeelsbeleid omarmt diversiteit en biedt iedereen gelijke kansen.

Natuurlijk hebben we daarnaast ook uitstekende arbeidsvoorwaarden en geweldige ontwikkelmogelijkheden:

  • een jaarcontract, met de absolute intentie om je na één jaar een contract voor onbepaalde tijd aan te bieden

  • een aantrekkelijk salaris tussen de € 6.100,– en € 9.295,–, afgestemd op jouw kennis en ervaring

Mid-Market Account Executive

About Nash

Nash is transforming last-mile logistics. Our platform helps merchants orchestrate deliveries across multiple carriers—from Doordash and Uber to regional DSPs—through a single, unified API and dashboard. We power same-day, next-day, and scheduled deliveries for some of the most innovative merchants in North America and beyond.

Our mission is simple: to drive global prosperity through more efficient delivery.

The Role

We’re looking for a Mid-Market Account Executive to accelerate Nash’s growth within the $10K–$100K ARR merchant segment. You’ll own the full sales cycle—from prospecting and qualification through demo, negotiation, and close—working directly with operations and technology leaders at some of the fastest-growing restaurant, grocery, retail, and catering brands.

You’ll be part of a high-caliber team that thrives on velocity, curiosity, and impact. This role is perfect for someone who’s hungry to sell a technical, high-value product that reshapes how goods move in the real world.

What You’ll Do

  • Drive new business acquisition across Nash’s Mid-Market segment (avg. deal size ~$35K ARR).

  • Manage the full sales cycle: prospecting, discovery, demo, proposal, negotiation, and close.

  • Build and maintain a strong pipeline through outbound outreach and inbound qualification.

  • Work cross-functionally with Solutions Engineering, Marketing, and Customer Success to tailor solutions for merchant workflows.

  • Deeply understand merchant pain points (delivery orchestration, cost per drop, operational complexity, and customer experience).

  • Consistently hit and exceed quota for new logos and booked consumption.

  • Maintain accurate forecasting and CRM hygiene in Salesforce.

What You’ll Bring

  • 3–6 years of full-cycle SaaS sales experience (ideally in logistics, ecommerce, or retail tech).

  • Proven success selling to operators, logistics managers, and technology buyers at mid-sized merchants.
    Strong discovery and consultative selling skills — you know how to uncover the “why.”

  • Comfortable running multi-stakeholder sales cycles (Ops, IT, Finance, Founders).

  • High velocity mindset — you thrive on activity, pipeline, and experimentation.

  • Proficiency with Salesforce, Gong, and modern sales tech stack (Outreach, Apollo, etc.).

  • Entrepreneurial spirit — you want to be part of building something from the ground up.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Competitive base salary + variable compensation (OTE aligned with top-quartile SaaS benchmarks).

  • Equity in a fast-growing venture-backed company.

  • Health, dental, vision, and 401(k).

  • Flexible PTO and remote-first culture.

Why Nash

At Nash, you’ll work alongside a team of builders and operators who’ve scaled some of the most impactful logistics and SaaS businesses globally. We move fast, challenge assumptions, and are laser-focused on outcomes. If you want to sell a product that directly impacts how the world moves — this is the place.

More about Nash

Nash is the platform that powers modern logistics.

Commerce has inverted. For decades, customers came to where products and services were. Now products and services come to them, on their terms, in real time. That shift has turned every company into a logistics company, even though almost none of them were built to be one. Couriers, fleets, gig workers, parcel carriers, in-store labor, and increasingly autonomous systems all have to be coordinated in real time, against tighter windows and rising expectations, with hard-fought customer trust on the line.

Nash unifies decisioning, execution, and capacity into a single programmable platform. Real-time, AI-native intelligence determines what should happen, operational control executes it, and the platform dynamically orchestrates capacity from any source: a company's own fleets, partners, or the Nash delivery network. Whether a job involves a courier, a gig driver, an internal fleet, a store employee, a technician, or an autonomous vehicle, Nash selects the right resource and manages execution through completion.

We power delivery and logistics for some of the most recognizable brands in commerce, including Walmart, Urban Outfitters, 7-Eleven, and Woolworths, alongside platforms like Shopify and Toast. Over the next decade, logistics will become as foundational to commerce as payments, cloud, and connectivity. Nash is the platform that powers it.

Nash was founded in 2021 by Mahmoud Ghulman (2x Founder, MIT) and Aziz Alghunaim (2x Founder, 2x YC, Ex-Palantir, MIT) and is backed by Y Combinator, a16z, and other top investors. We are headquartered in San Francisco.

jobs.description:
Software Engineer, Infrastructure Security

About the Team

Security is at the foundation of OpenAI’s mission to ensure that artificial general intelligence benefits all of humanity.

The Security team protects OpenAI’s technology, people, and products. We are technical in what we build but operational in how we execute, and we support every product and research effort at OpenAI. Our tenets include prioritizing for impact, enabling researchers and developers, preparing for future transformative technologies, and fostering a strong, collaborative security culture.

About the Role

OpenAI is seeking a Security Software Engineer to join the Infrastructure Security (InfraSec) team.

InfraSec safeguards the core of OpenAI’s research and production environments—GPU supercomputing clusters, multi-cloud infrastructure, datacenters, networking, storage, and the critical services that power our frontier AI models. Our charter spans everything from bare-metal hardware and firmware to Kubernetes clusters, service meshes, and the data pathways that carry highly sensitive model weights and user data.

As a Security Software Engineer, you will design and build critical foundational services, such as authentication systems, egress/ingress proxies, access brokers, and key management platforms, that demand high standards of reliability, scalability, and software craftsmanship. These systems form the security backbone of OpenAI’s supercomputing environment and must remain robust under intense scale and adversarial pressure.

In this role, you will:

  • Architect and implement production-grade security services (e.g., auth services, access brokers, secure proxies, key-management infrastructure) that provide strong guarantees across hardware, operating systems, Kubernetes, networks, and CI/CD.

  • Partner with infrastructure and research engineers to embed security into high-performance compute clusters, enabling rapid model training and deployment without compromising protection.

  • Develop automation and detection tooling to continuously identify and mitigate risks in large-scale cloud and on-prem environments.

  • Drive high-impact initiatives such as line-speed encryption, machine identity, and network isolation, continuously raising the security bar for emerging AI workloads.

  • Lead or participate in design reviews and threat models to ensure new systems launch with strong security foundations and operational excellence.

You will thrive in this role if you have:

  • Strong software engineering skills in languages such as Python, Go, Rust, or C/C++, with a track record of shipping and operating high-reliability distributed services.

  • Experience building or operating critical security infrastructure (e.g., auth services, service-to-service proxies, certificate or key-management systems).

  • Deep understanding of security principles, best practices, and common vulnerabilities.

  • Expertise in securing large-scale cloud platforms (e.g., Azure, AWS, GCP), including multi-cloud networks and cloud-agnostic system design.

  • Familiarity with container and orchestration security (Kubernetes, service meshes) and modern authentication/authorization standards (OIDC, mTLS, SPIFFE/SPIRE).

  • A proactive mindset, with the ability to identify and address security gaps or inefficiencies through automation and tooling.

  • A track record of delivering scalable solutions and driving impactful changes across infrastructure in real-world projects.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with an ability to think critically and objectively assess security risks.

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to convey complex security concepts to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Excitement about collaborating with cross-functional teams to build secure, reliable systems that scale globally.

About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity.

jobs.title: Senior Product Engineer (DevTools & AI reliability, remote)
jobs.description:
Senior Product Engineer (DevTools & AI reliability, remote)

(Fully remote, async-first, DevTools SaaS, 32-40h/week, time zones: UTC-3 to UTC+3)

The best developers don't wait for a customer to tell them something's broken.

They catch it first, in the pull request, in staging, or in the checkout flow at 3am, before a single user notices. That instinct is Checkly's whole reason to exist. We give developers and their agents the tools to own reliability the way they own their code: end-to-end tests and synthetic monitoring defined as code, powered by OpenTelemetry and Playwright, versioned and reviewed like everything else they ship. From pull request to post-mortem, in one place.

Thousands of them, from modern AI companies like Mistral and resolve.ai to large engineering orgs like LinkedIn, Citi, and 1Password, build with us. In 2024 we raised $20M in Series B funding from Balderton, CRV and Accel.

Here's the thing about 2026: AI agents and coding assistants are shipping more software, faster, than any team could review by hand, and more of it is breaking in ways nobody has seen before. LLM-backed features fail probabilistically. Agents take actions no runbook anticipated. "Is my app healthy?" is becoming an unanswerable question for a whole generation of AI-native software. You will build reliability for this kind of software.

Our stack is AI (Codex, Claude, use what you like best), Vue.js, TypeScript, Node.js, Golang, Postgres, ClickHouse and AWS. We ship to prod all day, every day. We practice Agile (not scrum) and take pride in good documentation and good looking products.

We’re a remote-first startup that keeps things simple—low on meetings, high on productivity, and always shipping. If you love building cool things, working async, actually listening to and working with customers, and keeping it lean, you’ll fit right in!

What you'll do

Build and ship with AI

You will actively use coding agents for full stack development, from exploring solutions and generating scaffolding to refactoring, test generation and debugging. At Checkly we push the limits of AI tools every day.

Talk to our users

You will talk directly to the developers, DevOps and Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) teams who are on-call, debugging incidents, or wiring Checkly into production pipelines. You will understand their workflows, pain points, and feedback. You use those conversations to validate ideas, course-correct early, and iterate on what you build. Customer calls and the weekly support rotation are part of the job, not a distraction from it.

Find the right problems to solve

In a world where the cost of building software trends to zero, the hard part is picking what to build. You will focus on real developer pain: flaky tests and flaky checks, unclear failures, noisy alerts. You will favour pragmatic solutions that ship quickly, validate assumptions in production, and compound into long-term reliability improvements.

Own your work end to end

From shaping the initial idea, through implementation and rollout, to watching how it behaves in production. You will take part in on-call and help support customers when things don’t work as expected.

What you should have

  • You have shipped features with AI, not just experimented with them. You have taken work from zero to shipped with a comparable stack, made implementation decisions that held up, and put things in front of real users.

  • You have built and run production software. You know the realities of operating software that people depend on: edge cases, incidents, regressions, and the need for observability and follow-up. You are not surprised when things break. You help fix them.

  • You can hold a product conversation, not just a technical one. You can look at a customer problem and reason about whether the thing we are about to build actually solves it.

  • You work well without an office around you. You are autonomous and self-motivated in a remote setup, and you still enjoy getting to know your colleagues and helping other people get unstuck.

  • FULLY remote role, within the UTC-3 to UTC+3 time zones. You need to be able to travel to (other) European countries without having to wait for a visa appointment, for our annual kickoff, a team meetup or a conference.

What you will hate about us

We would rather tell you now than have you find out in month two.

  • We use AI for everything, and we mean everything. AI skepticism is not a thing here. If you have the slightest hesitation about working with AI every day, this is not the place for you, and that is completely fine.

  • We write more than we talk. We are async-first, so a lot of decisions happen in documents and threads, not meetings. If you do your best thinking out loud in a room full of people, you will miss it here.

  • We are lean, so you own the unglamorous parts too. There is no separate QA team, no ops layer to hand things off to, and you are on the support rotation and the on-call rotation like everyone else.

  • We ship constantly and change our minds. Priorities move as we learn from customers. If you need long, stable planning cycles, this will feel chaotic.

  • Customer signals come first, and most of the time they matter more than your instinct. We build what customers actually want, not the clever thing we dreamed up.

Benefits

  • Transparent salary because your salary shouldn't be dictated by how good a negotiator you are. (more info below)

  • Remote-first, flexible work hours, async-first (low meeting, high productivity) and transparent culture

  • Become part of a fast-growing, international, and remote team where your work matters, and your impact won't get lost in layers of bureaucracy.

  • Stock options

  • 27 days of paid vacation + your local public holidays

  • Paid sick leave & up to 14 weeks of paid parental leave

  • Co-working budget or home office setup

  • Annual company kickoffs

Find out more here.

What we pay

Fair, competitive, and transparent pay is very important for us. Therefore we work with a standardized salary calculator that includes several factors such as seniority level as well as location.

For this role, the range is

  • €88k - €105k for someone in a similar cost of market as UK, Germany etc, + stock options

  • €79k - €97k for someone in a similar cost of market as Spain, Poland, Ukraine etc, + stock options

Apply

If this sounds interesting, please apply! Studies by several different sources have shown that on average men will apply for a job if they meet 60% of the application requirements. Women, non-binary people and POC will seek to match a much higher percentage of requirements before applying. If you're not sure you're the right fit, apply anyway and let us know what you bring to the table. We'd love to hear from you!

We're all about being transparent and setting clear expectations. That's why we've put together our hiring playbook and open-sourced our employee handbook. There you'll find a sneak peek of who we are, how we work and what you can expect in our hiring process.

Compensation: €79K – €105K • Offers Equity • Multiple Ranges

Campaign Manager (m/f/d)

About Yepoda

Clean K-Beauty Innovation. No compromises.

Yepoda is a clean K-Beauty brand that actually proves it works. We make Korean skincare without any of the compromises. Everything is clinically tested, 100% vegan, and formulated above EU standards. So you get the innovation and the results that K-Beauty is known for, plus a real commitment to sustainability. And we make it genuinely fun and easy to use — skincare you actually look forward to.

Founded in 2020 by Sander Joonyoung van Bladel and Veronika Strotmann, Yepoda is a certified B Corp™ and 1% for the Planet member, based in the heart of Berlin. Our products are available through our own online shop and, since March 2025, at Sephora Europe — online and in over 650 stores. With a team of 140+ brilliant individuals from around the world, we are actively shaping Yepoda's story every day.

As Campaign Manager, you are an excellent project and process lead with a commercial marketing background. You are not the creative: the concepts, copy and ads are made by our Brand, Content and channel teams. Your job is to make sure our activities get launched in the best possible way, with thorough tracking.

You'll join the commercial planning team, working closely with our concept, brand and marketing teams and make sure our activities are executed smoothly. Every year you will run 15-20+ campaigns across up to 8 markets, from launches and our seasonal sales to our biggest moments.

Your tasks

  • Run the campaigns from start to finish. Bring the right people in the room together from the product kickoff onwards, so we get the best concepts.

  • Write the campaign briefs, with objectives, targets and all the details needed to approve before kick-off.

  • Chase for the deliverables. Manage our marketing channel stakeholders (Creative, storytelling, assets, product copy, influencer briefs, landing pages, CRM flows, retail materials, market adaptation) and keep everyone on the same brief and dates.

  • Adapt per market, working with the country leads on what changes locally, ensuring we are agile and localize the campaigns accordingly.

  • You are responsible for ensuring that we are ready before go-live. Detail oriented and escalating proactively if anything is missing.

  • Keep the process light and current. Maintain the Notion campaign templates, the RACI and campaign pages so everyone has the information needed to succeed.

  • Put together all learnings and results post-campaigns together. Ensure we have inputs from all teams and stakeholders. The post-mortem is based on evidence,

  • Bring in market trends, competitor promotions and cultural moments to sharpen every campaign

  • Plan for every channel according to the calendar: Sephora, Amazon and TikTok Shop alongside our own sites, with assets, timing and price parity aligned.

Your profile

  • 3–5 years in advertising (account or strategy side), or in growth or campaign marketing at a D2C brand. You know how to hold others accountable and are detail oriented.

  • You have delivered multi-channel, multi-market campaigns on time and can show the plans behind them

  • You can write and judge headlines, hooks and CTAs

  • You work well with Brand and Creative teams, hold the commercial line without friction, and align people you don’t manage

  • You think in revenue, sell-through, AOV and margin, and can argue why one offer beats another

  • You take ownership, bring solutions and keep process light

  • Fluent English; a second EU language is a plus

  • Beauty or D2C experience is a plus

What We Offer

  • Dynamic Environment: The opportunity to work in a start-up environment surrounded by a passionate and dedicated team.

  • Accelerate Your Career: Take on responsibility from day 1, with room for professional growth and advancement as the company continues to expand.

  • Inspiring Workspace: Located in the heart of Berlin's Prenzlauer Berg, a dog-friendly office, with free drinks and snacks.

  • Hybrid Working: We understand that sometimes you get more stuff done from home and need a change of scenery.

  • We Value Diversity: We seek to build an inclusive workplace that welcomes people from all different backgrounds. A welcoming, international, dedicated team with flat hierarchies and trust by default.

  • Employee Discounts: You’ll get to enjoy the Yepoda products at a discount and share it with friends and family to keep your glow going!

  • Unique Add Ons: A monthly benefits budget that's yours to spend. Through the Probonio app you pick what actually fits your lifestyle.

Would you like to be part of the team? Then we'd love to hear from you! 🫰✨

Make sure to apply by clicking on the “Apply for this job” button below. Please upload your CV and Cover Letter in English language. Our Talent Acquisition team will review your application and get back to you as soon as possible.

Bei Tion verfolgen wir das Ziel, den Übergang zu einer sauberen Energiezukunft zu beschleunigen und wir sind auf der Suche nach Menschen, die uns mit Leidenschaft auf dieser spannenden Reise begleiten.

Als Portfoliounternehmen von EQT investieren wir in Energieinfrastruktur und verfügen über ein wachsendes Portfolio von 800+ MW an Solar- und Windprojekten. Gemeinsam arbeiten wir daran, eine führende Plattform für Investitionen in Energiewendeprojekte zu werden. Wir sind ein dynamisches, innovatives Team, das sich durch gemeinsame Problemlösungen, Eigenverantwortung, Leidenschaft und Integrität auszeichnet. Wir suchen jetzt ein neues Teammitglied, das die Zukunft von Tion im Bereich der erneuerbaren Energien mitgestalten möchte. Klingt aufregend? Werde ein Tioneer.

Um mehr über uns zu erfahren, besuche www.tion-renewables.com oder verbinde dich mit uns auf LinkedIn. Ließ gerne weiter, um mehr über die Rolle zu erfahren und wie Du zu Tions Entwicklung beitragen kannst.

  • Das aktive Stakeholder-Management mit Grundstückseigentümern, Kommunen, Genehmigungsbehörden, Netzbetreibern, Beratern und Entwicklungspartnern

  • Die Beobachtung von Markt-, Regulierungs- und Technologieentwicklungen und deren Übersetzung in Projektstrategie und Risikobewertung

  • Die Erstellung und Präsentation von Entscheidungsvorlagen, Investment Cases und Projektupdates für Senior Management, Investment Committee und Geschäftsführung

PLEASE HAND IN YOUR APPLICATION DOCUMENTS IN ENGLISH ONLY

Erfahrung im Aufbau oder in der Skalierung eines Neobrokers, einer Direktbank oder eines Fintechs. Erfahrung mit KI- beziehungsweise LLM-gestützten Servicelösungen. Vertiefte Kenntnisse im Zahlungsverkehr und in der Steuerung wesentlicher Auslagerungen nach MaRisk AT 9.

Director, International Expansion — CEO Office
jobs.description:
Director, International Expansion — CEO Office

About Airwallex

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles to see it in full.

 

About the team

The CEO Office partners directly with Airwallex's executive leadership on the company's most important priorities. We work across regions and functions to shape the company's direction, solve complex problems, and turn ambitious ideas into reality.

International expansion is a core strategic priority for Airwallex. As we continue to build a truly global financial platform, we are expanding into new markets, securing regulatory licences, deepening our local financial infrastructure, and bringing new products to customers around the world.

We operate at the intersection of strategy, regulation, product, and execution, working closely with leaders across Product, Engineering, Legal, Risk, Finance, and Operations. The team combines strategic thinking with an entrepreneurial, hands-on approach to building and scaling our international presence.

What you'll do

As Director, International Expansion, you will lead Airwallex's expansion into new markets globally, shaping where and how we grow and building the regulatory, product, and operational foundations to succeed.

You will own a portfolio of market-entry initiatives end to end, from evaluating opportunities and defining entry strategies through licensing, product localisation, operational readiness, and commercial launch.

Reporting to the CEO's Chief of Staff, you will lead a lean team and work directly with senior executives to influence strategic decisions, mobilise cross-functional teams, and overcome the complex challenges of entering new markets.

This is a high-impact leadership role for someone who combines strategic judgment, an entrepreneurial mindset, and the ability to translate ambitious plans into tangible outcomes. You will build and lead the expansion function while remaining directly involved in the most strategically important and complex market-entry initiatives.

Responsibilities

  • Lead global expansion strategy: Own the strategy and execution of Airwallex's expansion into new markets globally. Evaluate and prioritise market opportunities, define entry strategies, and recommend where and how Airwallex should invest to establish and scale its presence.

  • Own market entry end to end: Lead expansion initiatives from initial market assessment through regulatory authorisation, entity establishment, product readiness, and operational launch. Take accountability for delivering market entries and navigating the strategic and execution challenges along the way.

  • Define regulatory and operating models: Work closely with Legal, Compliance, Risk, and Finance to determine the optimal licensing, legal entity, and operating structures for each market. Translate regulatory requirements into practical, scalable business models that support Airwallex's long-term ambitions.

  • Influence product and infrastructure strategy: Partner with Product and Engineering leadership to shape local product capabilities, payment infrastructure, and market-specific roadmaps. Identify opportunities to deepen Airwallex's presence through new licences, direct payment-system access, and expanded product offerings.

  • Lead a high-performing team: Manage and develop a lean team, setting clear priorities, providing strategic guidance, and driving accountability across multiple markets. Personally lead the highest-priority or most complex initiatives while building the team's capabilities.

  • Drive executive alignment and investment decisions: Work directly with the CEO's Chief of Staff and senior executives to shape expansion priorities, resolve critical trade-offs, secure resources, and drive timely decisions. Present clear recommendations on market opportunities, regulatory strategy, investment requirements, and launch readiness.

  • Build external relationships: Partner with local regulators, financial institutions, payment networks, advisers, and other strategic stakeholders to support regulatory approvals, establish local capabilities, and unlock new market opportunities.

  • Build a scalable expansion engine: Develop repeatable frameworks, tools, and operating processes that enable Airwallex to expand faster and more efficiently. Leverage AI and automation to improve regulatory intelligence, market analysis, execution tracking, and cross-functional coordination.

  • Drive broader CEO Office priorities: Support or lead high-impact strategic initiatives beyond international expansion, working across the business to solve complex problems, shape company-level decisions, and drive execution on critical priorities.

Who you are

Minimum qualifications:

  • Intellectually curious, resilient, and hungry to win. You thrive on solving difficult problems, challenge conventional thinking, learn quickly, and have the drive and persistence to turn ambitious goals into results.

  • Significant experience in strategy, international expansion, business operations, or related roles, ideally in fintech, payments, banking, or other high-growth technology businesses.

  • Strong strategic and commercial judgment, with the ability to navigate ambiguity, evaluate complex trade-offs, and translate big-picture thinking into practical execution.

  • Demonstrated ability to lead teams and complex cross-functional initiatives, influence senior stakeholders, and drive outcomes in fast-paced environments.

  • Exceptional analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills, with the ability to simplify complexity, make sound decisions, and engage effectively with executive leadership.

  • Entrepreneurial, hands-on mindset with a strong sense of ownership and willingness to get into the details to make things happen.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Proven track record of leading international market entries, including regulatory licensing, market-entry strategy, and operational launches.

  • Experience in fintech, payments, or financial services, with an understanding of regulatory frameworks, financial infrastructure, and the interplay between licensing, product, and commercial strategy.

  • Experience building and leading high-performing teams in high-growth, cross-functional environments.

Applicant Safety Policy: Fraud and Third-Party Recruiters

To protect you from recruitment scams, please be aware that Airwallex will not ask for bank details, sensitive ID numbers (i.e. passport), or any form of payment during the application or interview process. All official communication will come from an @airwallex.com email address. Please apply only through careers.airwallex.com or our official LinkedIn page.

Airwallex does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms/recruiters. Airwallex will not pay any fees to search firms/recruiters if a candidate is submitted by a search firm/recruiter unless an agreement has been entered into with respect to specific open position(s). Search firms/recruiters submitting resumes to Airwallex on an unsolicited basis shall be deemed to accept this condition, regardless of any other provision to the contrary.

Equal opportunity

Airwallex is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and anyone seeking employment at Airwallex is considered based on merit, qualifications, competence and talent. We don’t regard color, religion, race, national origin, sexual orientation, ancestry, citizenship, sex, marital or family status, disability, gender, or any other legally protected status when making our hiring decisions. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.
